  1992	  // Timing breakdown
  1993	  if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
  1994	    DSP_DIAG(TIMING, "replay: graph=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots) sbs=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots)",
  1995	             graphReplayUs, graphReplaySegs, graphReplaySlots,
  1996	             slotBySlotUs, slotBySlotSegs, slotBySlotSlots);
  1997	  }
  1998	
  1999	  if (stats != nullptr) {
  2000	    stats->graphReplayUs = graphReplayUs;
  2001	    stats->slotBySlotUs = slotBySlotUs;
  2002	    stats->graphReplaySegs = graphReplaySegs;
  2003	    stats->slotBySlotSegs = slotBySlotSegs;
  2004	    stats->graphReplaySlots = graphReplaySlots;
  2005	    stats->slotBySlotSlots = slotBySlotSlots;
  2006	  }
  2007	
  2008	  return Status::OK;
  2009	}
  2010	
  2011	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::clearShapeCaches() {
  2012	  // When shapes are frozen, skip clearing entirely after first execution.
  2013	  // All cached shapes remain valid since external input shapes are constant.
  2014	  if (shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ > 0) return;
  2015	
  2016	  for (int i = 0; i < numSlots_; i++) {
  2017	    if (!slots_[i].shapeCache.shapeStatic) {
  2018	      slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  2019	      slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedOutputShapes.clear();
  2020	      // Demote to WARMUP if currently beyond warmup (non-static slots need re-inference)
  2021	      if (slots_[i].state_ > NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP) {
  2022	        slots_[i].state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP;
  2023	      }
  2024	    }
  2025	  }
  2026	}
  2027	
  2028	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::clearAllShapeCachesForce() {
  2029	  DSP_REQUIRE_PLAN_PHASE_AT_MOST(PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN, "clearAllShapeCachesForce");
  2030	  for (int i = 0; i < numSlots_; i++) {
  2031	    slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  2032	    slots_[i].shapeCache.cachedOutputShapes.clear();
  2033	    // Force demote all slots to WARMUP
  2034	    if (slots_[i].state_ > NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP) {
  2035	      slots_[i].state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::WARMUP;
  2036	    }
  2037	  }
  2038	}
  2039	
  2040	// ─── Reset segment execution state ──────────────────────────────────────────
  2041	
  2042	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::resetSegmentExecutionState() {
  2043	  demotePlanPhase(PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT, "resetSegmentExecutionState");
  2044	  for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  2045	    seg.exec.executionCount = 0;
  2046	    seg.exec.compilationFailed = false;
  2047	    seg.exec.captureOomRetries = 0;
  2048	    if (seg.exec.replayHandle) seg.exec.replayHandle.reset();
  2049	    seg.exec.argTableStable = false;
  2050	    seg.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::WARMUP;
  2051	  }
  2052	  compilationDone_ = false;
  2053	}
  2054	
  2055	// ─── Release GPU intermediates ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  2056	
  2057	
  2058	int NativeDynamicShapePlan::releaseGpuIntermediates() {
  2059	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: START plan=%p numSlots=%d totalOutputSlots=%d",
  2060	           this, numSlots_, totalOutputSlots_);
  2061	
  2062	  // ── Phase demotion: demote to SLOT_BY_SLOT BEFORE freeing any arrays ──────
  2063	  // This ensures no code path can observe POINTERS_STABLE/REPLAYING phase
  2064	  // while buffers are being freed, which would violate the phase contract
  2065	  // (those phases guarantee stable buffer pointers).
  2066	  {
  2067	    static const char* phaseNames[] = {"SLOT_BY_SLOT", "SHAPES_FROZEN", "POINTERS_STABLE", "REPLAYING"};
  2068	    const char* oldPhaseName = phaseNames[static_cast<int>(planPhase_)];
  2069	    static const char* reasonNames[] = {"NORMAL_CLOSE", "SESSION_RESET", "OOM_RECOVERY",
  2070	                                         "DEVICE_SWITCH", "CAPTURE_FAILURE", "SHAPE_CHANGE", "ERROR_RECOVERY"};
  2071	    const char* reasonName = reasonNames[static_cast<int>(destructionReason_)];
  2072	    if (planPhase_ != PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT) {
  2073	      DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "releaseGpuIntermediates: demoting planPhase_ %s → SLOT_BY_SLOT "
  2074	               "reason=%s before freeing arrays", oldPhaseName, reasonName);
  2075	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
  2076	      pointersStable_ = false;
  2077	      frozenExecutionCount_ = 0;
  2078	    }
  2079	  }
  2080	
  2081	  // ── Step 1: Free per-segment GPU resources (CUDA graphs, capture workspaces,
  2082	  //            pinned host pointers) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  2083	  // This is the same cleanup as the destructor's platformFreePlanResources(),
  2084	  // but we keep the segment metadata (slot ranges, op definitions) intact.
  2085	  platformReleaseSegmentGpuResources();
  2086	
  2087	  // ── Step 2: Free non-weight NDArrays from outputSlots_ ─────────────────
  2088	  // Only free SLOT_OWNED buffers. Views and weights are externally owned.
  2089	  //
  2090	  //  Re-classify ownership before freeing. After CUDA graph capture,
  2091	  // outputSlots_[] is restored to warmup arrays (line 2716 in gpubackend.cpp)
  2092	  // but slotOwnership_[] still reflects capture-time classification. The warmup
  2093	  // arrays may have different ownership than the capture arrays:
  2094	  //   - Warmup array has unique buffer → should be SLOT_OWNED → must be freed
  2095	  //   - Capture array shared buffer with weight → was VIEW_OF_WEIGHT
  2096	  // Without re-classification, warmup arrays with unique buffers are skipped
  2097	  // (classified as VIEW_OF_WEIGHT from capture), leaking ~1.7 GB per page cycle.
  2098	  int freedCount = 0;
  2099	  std::unordered_set<NDArray*> deleted;
  2100	
  2101	  if (outputSlots_) {
  2102	    // Re-classify ownership for ALL slots based on the CURRENT outputSlots_[] arrays.
  2103	    // protectedWeightBuffers_ contains DataBuffers from ALL external inputs (built
  2104	    // during execute()). Any slot whose DataBuffer matches an external input is
  2105	    // BORROWED (model-owned, never freed by the plan). Everything else is an
  2106	    // intermediate (plan-owned, freed here).
  2107	    if (slotOwnership_) {
  2108	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2109	        slotOwnership_[i].reset();
  2110	        if (outputSlots_[i] == nullptr) continue;
  2111	        auto* db = outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer();
  2112	        if (db == nullptr) {
  2113	          slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::UNSET;
  2114	          continue;
  2115	        }
  2116	        if (protectedWeightBuffers_.count(db) > 0) {
  2117	          slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_WEIGHT;
  2118	          slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  2119	          continue;
  2120	        }
  2121	        bool isViewOfSlot = false;
  2122	        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
  2123	          if (outputSlots_[j] != nullptr && outputSlots_[j]->dataBuffer() == db) {
  2124	            slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_SLOT;
  2125	            slotOwnership_[i].parentSlotIdx = j;
  2126	            slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  2127	            isViewOfSlot = true;
  2128	            break;
  2129	          }
  2130	        }
  2131	        if (!isViewOfSlot) {
  2132	          slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::SLOT_OWNED;
  2133	          slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  2134	        }
  2135	      }
  2136	      DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: re-classified ownership for %d slots "
  2137	               "(%zu protected external buffers)", totalOutputSlots_, protectedWeightBuffers_.size());
  2138	    }
  2139	
  2140	    if (slotOwnership_) {
  2141	      // First pass: null out all VIEW_OF_SLOT entries (they'll be invalidated
  2142	      // when their parent SLOT_OWNED buffer is freed).
  2143	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2144	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr &&
  2145	            slotOwnership_[i].ownership == BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_SLOT) {
  2146	          // Don't delete — the parent owns the buffer. Just null out.
  2147	          outputSlots_[i] = nullptr;
  2148	          slotOwnership_[i].reset();
  2149	        }
  2150	      }
  2151	      // Second pass: free SLOT_OWNED buffers that are plan-owned.
  2152	      // Only delete arrays the plan created (in planOwnedArrays_).
  2153	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2154	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr &&
  2155	            slotOwnership_[i].ownership == BufferOwnership::SLOT_OWNED) {
  2156	          slotOwnership_[i].viewRefCount = 0;
  2157	          if (planOwnedArrays_.count(outputSlots_[i]) > 0 &&
  2158	              deleted.insert(outputSlots_[i]).second) {
  2159	            planOwnedArrays_.erase(outputSlots_[i]);
  2160	            delete outputSlots_[i];
  2161	            freedCount++;
  2162	          }
  2163	          outputSlots_[i] = nullptr;
  2164	          slotOwnership_[i].reset();
  2165	        }
  2166	      }
  2167	    } else {
  2168	      // Fallback: no ownership info — only free plan-owned arrays
  2169	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2170	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr && planOwnedArrays_.count(outputSlots_[i]) > 0) {
  2171	          if (deleted.insert(outputSlots_[i]).second) {
  2172	            planOwnedArrays_.erase(outputSlots_[i]);
  2173	            delete outputSlots_[i];
  2174	            freedCount++;
  2175	          }
  2176	          outputSlots_[i] = nullptr;
  2177	        }
  2178	      }
  2179	    }
  2180	  }
  2181	  platformMigrateWeightsAndClearCaches();
  2182	
  2183	  // ── Step 5: Reset execution state so plan re-warms on next execute() ────
  2184	  viewProducerDetectionDone_ = false;
  2185	  frozenConstantDetectionDone_ = false;
  2186	  executeCount_ = 0;
  2187	  compilationDone_ = false;
  2188	  // Remove frozen reference counts from weight DataBuffers before clearing
  2189	  // shapesFrozen_. During frozen execution, addFrozenRef() was called on each
  2190	  // protectedWeightBuffer to prevent DataBuffer::migrate() from relocating
  2191	  // buffers whose addresses are baked into frozen slot contexts / CUDA graphs.
  2192	  // Now that all graphs and frozen state are torn down, migration is safe again.
  2193	  if (shapesFrozen_) {
  2194	    for (auto* db : protectedWeightBuffers_) {
  2195	      if (db != nullptr) {
  2196	        db->removeFrozenRef();
  2197	      }
  2198	    }
  2199	    
  2200	    // ALSO remove frozen ref count from all output slot DataBuffers.
  2201	    // These were protected during frozen execution to prevent SIGSEGV.
  2202	    if (outputSlots_ != nullptr) {
  2203	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  2204	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr && outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer() != nullptr) {
  2205	          outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer()->removeFrozenRef();
  2206	        }
  2207	      }
  2208	      DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: removed frozen ref from %d output slot DataBuffers", totalOutputSlots_);
  2209	    }
  2210	  }
  2211	  // Reset shapesFrozen_ so the plan goes through the full warmup-capture-replay
  2212	  // lifecycle from scratch. Without this, stale segment state (shapeKey, cachedShapeKey)
  2213	  // causes Triton recompilation to be skipped, and the plan tries to replay
  2214	  // CUDA graphs that were destroyed, leading to error 700.
  2215	  shapesFrozen_ = false;
  2216	
  2217	  // Disable KV cache retention — after releasing intermediates, the output slots
  2218	  // that KV scatter reads from are NULL. The next page's decode loop will
  2219	  // re-configure retention at the correct position via configureKvCacheRetention().
  2220	  // Without this, a restored cached handle runs KV scatter with stale position
  2221	  // against empty destination buffers, causing CUDA error 700.
  2222	  kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ = false;
  2223	  kvCachePosition_ = 0;
  2224	
  2225	  // Clear shape caches so shapes are re-inferred
  2226	  clearAllShapeCachesForce();
  2227	
  2228	  // Clear GPU backend failed-segment cache
  2229	  clearGpuBackendFailedCache();
  2230	
  2231	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates: DONE plan=%p, freed %d arrays. "
  2232	           "Plan is now cold — next execute() will re-warm.", this, freedCount);
  2233	
  2234	  return freedCount;
  2235	}
  2236	
  2237	int NativeDynamicShapePlan::releaseGpuIntermediates(bool preserveDecodeState) {
  2238	  if (preserveDecodeState) {
  2239	    // Decode-invariant path: preserve slot arrays, CUDA graphs, cuBLAS workspace,
  2240	    // and batch optimization resources. Only reset KV cache position and decode
  2241	    // input pending state.
  2242	    DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "releaseGpuIntermediates(preserve=true): preserving decode-invariant state");
  2243	    
  2244	    // Reset KV cache position for next page
  2245	    kvCachePosition_ = 0;
  2246	    
  2247	    // Clear pending decode update flag
  2248	    hasPendingDecodeUpdate_ = false;
  2249	    pendingTokenId_ = 0;
  2250	    pendingCachePos_ = 0;
  2251	    
  2252	    // No GPU memory freed — returning 0
  2253	    return 0;
  2254	  } else {
  2255	    // Full release — call the existing method
  2256	    return releaseGpuIntermediates();
  2257	  }
  2258	}
  2259	
  2260	// ─── KV cache retention ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  2261	
  2262	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::configureKvCacheRetention(
  2263	    const int* mappings, int numMappings, int maxKvLen, int initialPos) {
  2264	  // Free existing mappings
  2265	  delete[] kvCacheMappings_;
  2266	
  2267	  kvCacheNumMappings_ = numMappings;
  2268	  kvCacheMaxLen_ = maxKvLen;
  2269	  kvCachePosition_ = initialPos;
  2270	
  2271	  if (numMappings > 0 && mappings != nullptr) {
  2272	    kvCacheMappings_ = new KvCacheMapping[numMappings];
  2273	    for (int i = 0; i < numMappings; i++) {
  2274	      // Java passes either:
  2275	      //   >= 0 : requested output index
  2276	      //   <= -2: direct absolute slot index encoded as -(slotIdx + 2)
  2277	      int outputRef = mappings[i * 3];
  2278	      int slotIdx = -1;
  2279	      if (outputRef <= -2) {
  2280	        slotIdx = -outputRef - 2;
  2281	        if (slotIdx < 0 || slotIdx >= totalOutputSlots_) slotIdx = -1;
  2282	      } else if (outputRef >= 0 && outputRef < numRequestedOutputs_) {
  2283	        slotIdx = requestedOutputSlotIndices_[outputRef];
  2284	      }
  2285	      kvCacheMappings_[i].presentOutputSlotIdx = slotIdx;
  2286	      kvCacheMappings_[i].pastInputExternalIdx = mappings[i * 3 + 1];
  2287	      kvCacheMappings_[i].seqDim = mappings[i * 3 + 2];
  2288	    }
  2289	    kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ = true;
  2290	
  2291	    // Retained for compatibility with the platform hook; replay now uses the
  2292	    // canonical KV buffers directly so this is a no-op on every backend.
  2293	    platformMarkKvCaptureBuffersNeverSkip();
  2294	
  2295	    DSP_DIAG(KV_CACHE, "KV cache retention configured: %d mappings, maxLen=%d, initialPos=%d",
  2296	             numMappings, maxKvLen, initialPos);
  2297	  } else {
  2298	    kvCacheMappings_ = nullptr;
  2299	    kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ = false;
  2300	  }
  2301	}

  2322	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::updateDecodeInputs(
  2323	    NDArray** externalInputs, int numExt,
  2324	    long long tokenId, int cachePos, void* stream) {

  2326	  // correct actuality flags, single stream for ordering with graph replay.
  2327	  // Note: for non-pinned H2D, cudaMemcpyAsync stages data before returning,
  2328	  // so stack-local source values are safe.

  2330	}
  2331	
  2332	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::setOutputSlotMaxSizes(const int* slotIndices, const LongType* maxSizes, int numSlots) {
  2333	  if (slotIndices == nullptr || maxSizes == nullptr || numSlots <= 0) return;
  2334	
  2335	  outputSlotMaxSizes_.clear();
  2336	  maxAllocatedSlots_.clear();
  2337	
  2338	  for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
  2339	    if (slotIndices[i] >= 0 && slotIndices[i] < totalOutputSlots_ && maxSizes[i] > 0) {
  2340	      outputSlotMaxSizes_[slotIndices[i]] = maxSizes[i];
  2341	    }
  2342	  }
  2343	}

  2352	
  2353	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::scatterKvEntries(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExt, void* stream) {
  2354	  if (!kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ || kvCacheNumMappings_ == 0) return;
  2355	
  2356	  // Scatter present KV outputs into external input (static) buffers.
  2357	  // GPU: uses kvScatter kernel + stream management.
  2358	  // CPU: uses operator() + assign() fallback.
  2359	  void* savedState = platformBeginKvScatter(stream);
  2360	
  2361	  auto resolveLiveArray = [](NDArray* arr) -> NDArray* {
  2362	    if (arr == nullptr) return nullptr;
  2363	    if (arr->isEmpty()) return arr;
  2364	    auto* db = arr->dataBuffer();
  2365	    return (db != nullptr && db->isValid()) ? arr : nullptr;
  2366	  };
  2367	
  2368	  // Collect valid scatter entries for batched dispatch
  2369	  std::vector<sd::ops::helpers::KvScatterEntry> batchEntries;
  2370	  batchEntries.reserve(kvCacheNumMappings_);
  2371	  // Track arrays for prepareSpecialUse/registerSpecialUse
  2372	  std::vector<std::pair<NDArray*, NDArray*>> scatterPairs;
  2373	  DataType batchDtype = DataType::HALF;  // default; set from first valid entry
  2374	
  2375	  int skipped = 0;
  2376	  for (int m = 0; m < kvCacheNumMappings_; m++) {
  2377	    KvCacheMapping& mapping = kvCacheMappings_[m];
  2378	
  2379	    int presentSlotIdx = mapping.presentOutputSlotIdx;
  2380	    if (presentSlotIdx < 0 || presentSlotIdx >= totalOutputSlots_) { skipped++; continue; }
  2381	
  2382	    NDArray* presentKv = resolveLiveArray(outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx]);
  2383	    if (presentKv == nullptr) {
  2384	      presentKv = resolveLiveArray(outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx]);
  2385	    } else if (outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx] != presentKv) {
  2386	      outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx] = presentKv;
  2387	    }
  2388	
  2389	    if (presentKv == nullptr) { skipped++; continue; }
  2390	
  2391	    int extIdx = mapping.pastInputExternalIdx;
  2392	    if (extIdx < 0 || extIdx >= numExt) { skipped++; continue; }
  2393	    NDArray* staticBuf = externalInputs[extIdx];
  2394	    if (staticBuf == nullptr) { skipped++; continue; }
  2395	
  2396	    if (presentKv->rankOf() != 4 || staticBuf->rankOf() != 4) { skipped++; continue; }
  2397	
  2398	    // Validate GPU buffer pointers are non-null and sequence dims are non-zero.
  2399	    // After resetForNextPage(), restored cached handles may encounter empty
  2400	    // destination buffers (shape [1,H,0,D]) whose specialBuffer() is nullptr.
  2401	    // Writing to nullptr causes CUDA error 700.
  2402	    NDArray::prepareSpecialUse({staticBuf}, {presentKv});
  2403	
  2404	    const void* srcBuf = DSP_BUF(presentKv);
  2405	    void* dstBuf = DSP_BUF(staticBuf);
  2406	    auto srcSeq = presentKv->sizeAt(2);
  2407	    auto dstSeq = staticBuf->sizeAt(2);
  2408	
  2409	    if (srcBuf == nullptr || dstBuf == nullptr || srcSeq <= 0 || dstSeq <= 0) {
  2410	      NDArray::registerSpecialUse({staticBuf}, {presentKv}); // balance the prepareSpecialUse
  2411	      skipped++;
  2412	      continue;
  2413	    }
  2414	
  2415	    // Validate cachePos is within the destination buffer's bounds
  2416	    if (kvCachePosition_ >= dstSeq) {
  2417	      NDArray::registerSpecialUse({staticBuf}, {presentKv}); // balance the prepareSpecialUse
  2418	      skipped++;
  2419	      continue;
  2420	    }
  2421	
  2422	    sd::ops::helpers::KvScatterEntry entry;
  2423	    entry.srcPtr = srcBuf;
  2424	    entry.dstPtr = dstBuf;
  2425	    entry.heads = presentKv->sizeAt(1);
  2426	    entry.srcSeqLen = srcSeq;
  2427	    entry.dstSeqLen = dstSeq;
  2428	    entry.dim = presentKv->sizeAt(3);
  2429	    entry.lastPos = entry.srcSeqLen - 1;
  2430	    entry.cachePos = kvCachePosition_;
  2431	    batchEntries.push_back(entry);
  2432	    if (scatterPairs.empty()) {
  2433	      batchDtype = presentKv->dataType();
  2434	    }
  2435	    scatterPairs.push_back({presentKv, staticBuf});
  2436	  }
  2437	
  2438	  int scattered = static_cast<int>(batchEntries.size());
  2439	  if (scattered > 0) {
  2440	    auto* lc = LaunchContext::defaultContext();
  2441	    sd::ops::helpers::kvScatterBatched(batchEntries.data(), scattered, batchDtype, lc);
  2442	
  2443	    platformPostKvScatterSync(scattered, kvCachePosition_, kvCacheNumMappings_);
  2444	  }
  2445	
  2446	  // Register special use for all pairs
  2447	  for (auto& pair : scatterPairs) {
  2448	    NDArray::registerSpecialUse({pair.second}, {pair.first});
  2449	  }
  2450	
  2451	  platformEndKvScatter(savedState);
  2452	
  2453	  DSP_DIAG(KV_CACHE, "KV scatter (batched): %d scattered, %d skipped, pos=%d, numMappings=%d, execCount=%lld",
  2454	           scattered, skipped, kvCachePosition_, kvCacheNumMappings_, (long long)executeCount_);
  2455	  if (DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(KV_CACHE) && scattered > 0) {
  2456	    auto& e0 = batchEntries[0];

    47	/**
    48	 * Caching layer for ONNX model imports.
    49	 *
    50	 * <p>Wraps {@link OnnxFrameworkImporter#runImport} with SDZ file caching.
    51	 * On the first import, the ONNX model is fully parsed and converted to SameDiff,
    52	 * then saved as an SDZ file alongside the original ONNX file. On subsequent runs,
    53	 * the SDZ file is loaded directly, bypassing ONNX parsing entirely.</p>
    54	 *
    55	 * <p>This reduces model loading time from ~5 minutes to ~30 seconds for
    56	 * typical VLM model sets (vision encoder + decoder + embed tokens).</p>
    57	 *
    58	 * <p>Cache invalidation uses file modification timestamps: if the ONNX file
    59	 * is newer than the cached SDZ, the cache is regenerated.</p>
    60	 *
    61	 * Adam Gibson
    62	 */
    63	@Slf4j
    64	public class OnnxModelCache {
    65	
    66	    /**
    67	     * System property to disable SDZ caching entirely.
    68	     * Set to "true" to always import from ONNX.
    69	     */
    70	    public static final String DISABLE_CACHE_PROPERTY = "vlm.model.cache.disable";
    71	
    72	    /**
    73	     * System property to control graph optimization after loading.
    74	     * Defaults to ON (true). Set to "false" to disable GraphOptimizer
    75	     * (constant folding, identity removal, attention fusion, FP16 pre-cast, etc.).
    76	     * Optimized graphs are cached separately as .opt.sdz files.
    77	     */
    78	    public static final String OPTIMIZER_ENABLED_PROPERTY = "nd4j.optimizer.enabled";
    79	
    80	    private OnnxModelCache() {
    81	        // utility class
    82	    }
    83	
    84	    /**
    85	     * Check if the optimizer is enabled. Defaults to true unless
    86	     * explicitly set to "false" via system property.
    87	     */
    88	    private static boolean isOptimizerEnabled() {
    89	        String prop = System.getProperty(OPTIMIZER_ENABLED_PROPERTY);
    90	        // Default to true — only disable if explicitly set to "false"
    91	        return prop == null || !"false".equalsIgnoreCase(prop.trim());
    92	    }
    93	
    94	    /**
    95	     * Import an ONNX model with SDZ file caching.
    96	     *
    97	     * <p>If a cached SDZ file exists alongside the ONNX file and is newer
    98	     * than the ONNX source, the cached SDZ is loaded directly. Otherwise,
    99	     * the full ONNX import is performed and the result is cached as SDZ
   100	     * for future runs.</p>
   101	     *
   102	     * @param onnxFilePath absolute path to the ONNX model file
   103	     * @return the imported SameDiff model
   104	     * @throws IOException if import or cache operations fail
   105	     */
   106	    private static final int MAX_LOAD_RETRIES = 3;
   107	    private static final long RETRY_DELAY_MS = 500;
   108	
   109	    public static SameDiff importWithCache(String onnxFilePath) throws IOException {
   110	        File onnxFile = new File(onnxFilePath);
   111	        if (!onnxFile.exists()) {
   112	            throw new IOException("ONNX file not found: " + onnxFilePath);
   113	        }
   114	
   115	        File sdzFile = getSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   116	        boolean cacheDisabled = Boolean.getBoolean(DISABLE_CACHE_PROPERTY);
   117	
   118	        // Acquire file lock to prevent concurrent read/write/delete of the SDZ cache.
   119	        // The lock file is adjacent to the SDZ file — all processes/threads contending
   120	        // for this model will serialize through this lock.
   121	        File lockFile = new File(sdzFile.getAbsolutePath() + ".lock");
   122	        lockFile.getParentFile().mkdirs();
   123	        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(lockFile, "rw");
   124	             FileChannel channel = raf.getChannel();
   125	             FileLock lock = channel.lock()) {
   126	            return importWithCacheLocked(onnxFile, sdzFile, cacheDisabled);
   127	        } catch (IOException e) {
   128	            // If locking fails (e.g., NFS without lock support), fall through without lock
   129	            log.warn("File locking failed for {}, proceeding without lock: {}", lockFile, e.getMessage());
   130	            return importWithCacheLocked(onnxFile, sdzFile, cacheDisabled);
   131	        }
   132	    }
   133	
   134	    private static SameDiff importWithCacheLocked(File onnxFile, File sdzFile, boolean cacheDisabled) throws IOException {
   135	
   136	        boolean optimizerEnabled = isOptimizerEnabled();
   137	
   138	        // Check for cached optimized SDZ first (if optimizer is enabled)
   139	        // The .opt.sdz must be newer than BOTH the .onnx source AND the base .sdz cache.
   140	        // If the base .sdz was regenerated (new import), the .opt.sdz is stale and must be re-optimized.
   141	        if (optimizerEnabled && !cacheDisabled) {
   142	            File optSdzFile = getOptimizedSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   143	            File baseSdzFile = getSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   144	            boolean optValid = optSdzFile.exists()
   145	                    && optSdzFile.lastModified() >= onnxFile.lastModified()
   146	                    && (!baseSdzFile.exists() || optSdzFile.lastModified() >= baseSdzFile.lastModified());
   147	            if (optValid) {
   148	                log.info("Loading cached optimized SDZ model: {} ({} bytes)", optSdzFile.getName(), optSdzFile.length());
   149	                long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
   150	                SameDiff sd = loadSdzWithRetry(optSdzFile);
   151	                if (sd != null) {
   152	                    long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;
   153	                    log.info("Loaded cached optimized SDZ model in {}ms: {}", elapsed, optSdzFile.getName());
   154	                    return sd;
   155	                }
   156	                log.warn("Failed to load optimized SDZ after retries, will re-import: {}", optSdzFile.getName());

   159	                log.info("Stale .opt.sdz detected, will re-optimize: {}", optSdzFile.getName());

   164	        // Use cached SDZ if it exists and is newer than the ONNX source

   167	            long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
   168	            SameDiff sd = loadSdzWithRetry(sdzFile);
   169	            if (sd != null) {

   175	            sdzFile.delete();
   176	        }
   177	
   178	        // Full ONNX import (first run or cache invalidated)
   179	        log.info("Importing ONNX model: {} (will cache as SDZ)", onnxFile.getName());
   180	        long importStart = System.currentTimeMillis();
   181	        OnnxFrameworkImporter importer = new OnnxFrameworkImporter();
   182	        SameDiff sd = importer.runImport(onnxFile.getAbsolutePath(), Map.of(), false, false);
   183	        long importElapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - importStart;
   184	        log.info("ONNX import completed in {}ms: {}", importElapsed, onnxFile.getName());
   185	
   186	        // Cache for future runs
   187	        try {
   188	            long saveStart = System.currentTimeMillis();
   189	            SDZSerializer.save(sd, sdzFile, false, Map.of(
   190	                    "source_onnx", onnxFile.getName(),
   191	                    "import_timestamp", String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis())
   192	            ));
   193	            long saveElapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - saveStart;
   194	            log.info("Cached SDZ model in {}ms: {} ({} bytes)", saveElapsed,
   195	                    sdzFile.getName(), sdzFile.length());
   196	        } catch (Exception e) {
   197	            log.warn("Failed to cache SDZ model (non-fatal): {}", e.getMessage());
   198	            // Delete partial SDZ file if save failed
   199	            if (sdzFile.exists()) {
   200	                sdzFile.delete();
   201	            }
   202	        }
   203	
   204	        return maybeOptimize(sd, onnxFile, optimizerEnabled, cacheDisabled);
   205	    }
   206	
   207	    /**
   208	     * Optionally run GraphOptimizer on the loaded model and cache the result.
   209	     */
   210	    private static SameDiff maybeOptimize(SameDiff sd, File onnxFile, boolean optimizerEnabled, boolean cacheDisabled) {
   211	        if (!optimizerEnabled) {
   212	            return sd;
   213	        }
   214	
   215	        int opsBefore = sd.getOps().size();
   216	        // Skip optimization for small models (embed_tokens, etc.)
   217	        // Also skip the vision encoder (< 3000 ops) which has a LONG constant
   218	        // endianness issue during dup(). The decoder (4441+ ops) is the target.
   219	        if (opsBefore < 3000) {
   220	            log.info("Skipping optimization for model {} ({} ops, threshold=3000)", onnxFile.getName(), opsBefore);
   221	            return sd;
   222	        }
   223	
   224	        log.info("Running GraphOptimizer on {} ({} ops)...", onnxFile.getName(), opsBefore);
   225	        long optStart = System.currentTimeMillis();
   226	
   227	        List<String> outputs = sd.outputs() != null ? new ArrayList<>(sd.outputs()) : new ArrayList<>();
   228	        SameDiff optimized = GraphOptimizer.optimize(sd, outputs);
   229	
   230	        int opsAfter = optimized.getOps().size();
   231	        long optElapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - optStart;
   232	        log.info("GraphOptimizer: {} -> {} ops ({} removed) in {}ms for {}",
   233	                opsBefore, opsAfter, opsBefore - opsAfter, optElapsed, onnxFile.getName());
   234	
   235	        // Cache the optimized graph for future runs
   236	        if (!cacheDisabled) {
   237	            File optSdzFile = getOptimizedSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   238	            try {
   239	                long saveStart = System.currentTimeMillis();
   240	                SDZSerializer.save(optimized, optSdzFile, false, Map.of(
   241	                        "source_onnx", onnxFile.getName(),
   242	                        "optimized", "true",
   243	                        "ops_before", String.valueOf(opsBefore),
   244	                        "ops_after", String.valueOf(opsAfter)
   245	                ));
   246	                long saveElapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - saveStart;
   247	                log.info("Cached optimized SDZ in {}ms: {} ({} bytes)",
   248	                        saveElapsed, optSdzFile.getName(), optSdzFile.length());
   249	            } catch (Exception e) {
   250	                log.warn("Failed to cache optimized SDZ (non-fatal): {}", e.getMessage());
   251	                if (optSdzFile.exists()) {
   252	                    optSdzFile.delete();
   253	                }
   254	            }
   255	        }
   256	
   257	        return optimized;
   258	    }
   259	
   260	    /**
   261	     * Load an SDZ file with retry logic for transient ZIP extraction failures.
   262	     * Returns null if all retries fail (caller should fall back to re-import).
   263	     */
   264	    private static SameDiff loadSdzWithRetry(File sdzFile) {
   265	        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_LOAD_RETRIES; attempt++) {
   266	            try {
   267	                return SDZSerializer.load(sdzFile, false);
   268	            } catch (Exception e) {
   269	                log.warn("SDZ load attempt {}/{} failed for {}: {}",
   270	                        attempt, MAX_LOAD_RETRIES, sdzFile.getName(), e.getMessage());
   271	                if (attempt < MAX_LOAD_RETRIES) {
   272	                    try {
   273	                        Thread.sleep(RETRY_DELAY_MS * attempt);
   274	                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
   275	                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
   276	                        return null;
   277	                    }
   278	                }
   279	            }
   280	        }
   281	        return null;
   282	    }
   283	
   284	    /**
   285	     * Import multiple ONNX models in parallel with SDZ caching.
   286	     *
   287	     * <p>Each model is imported/loaded on a separate thread. This is safe
   288	     * because ONNX parsing is CPU-bound and each OnnxFrameworkImporter
   289	     * instance is independent. SDZ loading is I/O-bound.</p>
   290	     *
   291	     * <p>All import threads are pinned to the primary GPU (the device with the
   292	     * most total memory). This prevents model constants from being scattered
   293	     * across multiple GPUs during loading — a smaller GPU may not have enough
   294	     * memory for a large model's constants, causing failover splits that lead
   295	     * to cross-device CUDA errors (error 700) during execution.</p>
   296	     *
   297	     * @param onnxFilePaths absolute paths to ONNX model files
   298	     * @return array of imported SameDiff models in the same order as the input paths
   299	     * @throws IOException if any import fails
   300	     */
   301	    public static SameDiff[] importAllWithCache(String... onnxFilePaths) throws IOException {
   302	        if (onnxFilePaths.length == 0) {
   303	            return new SameDiff[0];
   304	        }
   305	        if (onnxFilePaths.length == 1) {
   306	            return new SameDiff[]{importWithCache(onnxFilePaths[0])};
   307	        }
   308	
   309	        // Disable DSP and CUDA graphs during model loading. Loading multiple models
   310	        // simultaneously is peak GPU memory usage — DSP compilation and CUDA graph
   311	        // capture allocate additional cached arrays and graph copies that push past OOM.
   312	        boolean dspWasEnabled = InferenceSession.isDynamicShapePlanEnabled();
   313	        String prevCudaGraphs = System.getProperty(ND4JSystemProperties.DSP_CUDA_GRAPHS_ENABLED);
   314	        InferenceSession.setDynamicShapePlanEnabled(false);
   315	        System.setProperty(ND4JSystemProperties.DSP_CUDA_GRAPHS_ENABLED, "false");
   316	        log.info("DSP and CUDA graphs disabled during model loading");
   317	
   318	        // Find the primary GPU (most total memory) for model loading.
   319	        int primaryDevice = selectPrimaryDevice();
   320	
   321	        // Check if ALL models have SDZ caches. If not, import sequentially to avoid
   322	        // CUDA thread-safety issues with parallel ONNX imports (each import creates
   323	        // thousands of NDArrays on the GPU, and concurrent CUDA context operations
   324	        // from multiple threads can cause stream synchronization failures).
   325	        boolean allCached = true;
   326	        boolean cacheDisabled = Boolean.getBoolean(DISABLE_CACHE_PROPERTY);
   327	        if (!cacheDisabled) {
   328	            for (String path : onnxFilePaths) {
   329	                File onnxFile = new File(path);
   330	                boolean optimizerEnabled = isOptimizerEnabled();
   331	                File optSdzFile = getOptimizedSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   332	                File sdzFile = getSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   333	                boolean hasCachedOpt = optimizerEnabled && optSdzFile.exists() &&
   334	                        optSdzFile.lastModified() >= onnxFile.lastModified();
   335	                boolean hasCached = sdzFile.exists() && sdzFile.lastModified() >= onnxFile.lastModified();
   336	                if (!hasCachedOpt && !hasCached) {
   337	                    allCached = false;
   338	                    break;
   339	                }
   340	            }
   341	        } else {
   342	            allCached = false;
   343	        }
   344	
   345	        long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
   346	
   347	        try {
   348	            SameDiff[] results;
   349	            if (allCached) {
   350	                // All models have SDZ caches — safe to load in parallel (I/O-bound, no CUDA contention)
   351	                log.info("Loading {} cached models in parallel (device {})...",
   352	                        onnxFilePaths.length, primaryDevice);
   353	                results = importAllParallel(onnxFilePaths, primaryDevice);
   354	            } else {
   355	                // Some models need ONNX import — import sequentially to avoid CUDA thread-safety issues
   356	                log.info("Importing {} models sequentially (some need ONNX import)...",
   357	                        onnxFilePaths.length);
   358	                results = new SameDiff[onnxFilePaths.length];
   359	                for (int i = 0; i < onnxFilePaths.length; i++) {
   360	                    results[i] = importWithCache(onnxFilePaths[i]);
   361	                }
   362	            }
   363	
   364	            long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;
   365	            log.info("All {} models loaded in {}ms (device {})",
   366	                    onnxFilePaths.length, elapsed, primaryDevice);
   367	            return results;
   368	        } finally {
   369	            // Restore DSP and CUDA graph settings
   370	            InferenceSession.setDynamicShapePlanEnabled(dspWasEnabled);
   371	            if (prevCudaGraphs != null) {
   372	                System.setProperty(ND4JSystemProperties.DSP_CUDA_GRAPHS_ENABLED, prevCudaGraphs);
   373	            } else {
   374	                System.clearProperty(ND4JSystemProperties.DSP_CUDA_GRAPHS_ENABLED);
   375	            }
   376	            log.info("DSP and CUDA graphs restored after model loading (dsp={}, cudaGraphs={})",
   377	                    dspWasEnabled, prevCudaGraphs != null ? prevCudaGraphs : "default");
   378	        }
   379	    }
   380	
   381	    /**
   382	     * Import all models in parallel using a thread pool.
   383	     */
   384	    private static SameDiff[] importAllParallel(String[] onnxFilePaths, int primaryDevice) throws IOException {
   385	        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(onnxFilePaths.length);
   386	        try {
   387	            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
   388	            Future<SameDiff>[] futures = new Future[onnxFilePaths.length];
   389	            for (int i = 0; i < onnxFilePaths.length; i++) {
   390	                final String path = onnxFilePaths[i];
   391	                final int deviceId = primaryDevice;
   392	                futures[i] = executor.submit(() -> {
   393	                    DeviceMemoryManager.getInstance().switchDevice(
   394	                            deviceId, "OnnxModelCache.importAllWithCache", "pin-import-thread");
   395	                    return importWithCache(path);
   396	                });
   397	            }
   398	
   399	            SameDiff[] results = new SameDiff[onnxFilePaths.length];
   400	            for (int i = 0; i < futures.length; i++) {
   401	                try {
   402	                    results[i] = futures[i].get();
   403	                } catch (ExecutionException e) {
   404	                    Throwable cause = e.getCause();
   405	                    if (cause instanceof IOException) {
   406	                        throw (IOException) cause;
   407	                    }
   408	                    throw new IOException("Failed to import: " + onnxFilePaths[i], cause);
   409	                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
   410	                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
   411	                    throw new IOException("Import interrupted: " + onnxFilePaths[i], e);
   412	                }
   413	            }
   414	            return results;
   415	        } finally {
   416	            executor.shutdown();
   417	        }
   418	    }
   419	
   420	    /**
   421	     * Select the primary GPU device (the one with the most total memory).
   422	     * This is where model constants should be loaded to avoid cross-device splits.
   423	     *
   424	     * @return device ID of the GPU with the most total memory
   425	     */
   426	    private static int selectPrimaryDevice() {
   427	        int numDevices = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getNumberOfDevices();
   428	        // Always query ALL physical GPUs (cudaGetDeviceCount), not just the ND4J-visible list.
   429	        // The ND4J affinity manager may restrict devices, but for model loading we want the
   430	        // biggest GPU regardless.
   431	        int physicalDevices = Nd4j.getNativeOps().getAvailableDevices();
   432	        log.info("selectPrimaryDevice: affinityManager reports {} devices, native reports {} physical GPUs",
   433	                numDevices, physicalDevices);
   434	
   435	        // Use the max of ND4J visible and physical device count to search ALL GPUs
   436	        int searchCount = Math.max(numDevices, physicalDevices);
   437	        if (searchCount <= 1) {
   438	            log.info("selectPrimaryDevice: single device system, using device 0");
   439	            return 0;
   440	        }
   441	
   442	        int bestDevice = 0;
   443	        long bestTotal = 0;
   444	        for (int d = 0; d < searchCount; d++) {
   445	            long totalMem = Nd4j.getNativeOps().getDeviceTotalMemory(d);
   446	            long freeMem = Nd4j.getNativeOps().getDeviceFreeMemory(d);
   447	            log.info("selectPrimaryDevice: device {} - total={} MB, free={} MB",
   448	                    d, totalMem / (1024 * 1024), freeMem / (1024 * 1024));
   449	            if (totalMem > bestTotal) {
   450	                bestTotal = totalMem;
   451	                bestDevice = d;
   452	            }
   453	        }
   454	        log.info("Primary device for model loading: device {} ({} MB total, {} devices searched)",
   455	                bestDevice, bestTotal / (1024 * 1024), searchCount);
   456	        return bestDevice;
   457	    }
   458	
   459	    /**
   460	     * Delete cached SDZ files for an ONNX model, forcing re-import on next load.
   461	     *
   462	     * @param onnxFilePath absolute path to the ONNX model file
   463	     * @return true if a cache file was deleted
   464	     */
   465	    public static boolean invalidateCache(String onnxFilePath) {
   466	        File onnxFile = new File(onnxFilePath);
   467	        boolean anyDeleted = false;
   468	
   469	        // Delete base SDZ cache
   470	        File sdzFile = getSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   471	        if (sdzFile.exists()) {
   472	            boolean deleted = sdzFile.delete();
   473	            if (deleted) {
   474	                log.info("Invalidated cache: {}", sdzFile.getName());
   475	                anyDeleted = true;
   476	            }
   477	        }
   478	
   479	        // Also delete optimized SDZ cache
   480	        File optSdzFile = getOptimizedSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   481	        if (optSdzFile.exists()) {
   482	            boolean deleted = optSdzFile.delete();
   483	            if (deleted) {
   484	                log.info("Invalidated optimized cache: {}", optSdzFile.getName());
   485	                anyDeleted = true;
   486	            }
   487	        }
   488	
   489	        return anyDeleted;
   490	    }
   491	
   492	    /**
   493	     * Check if a cached SDZ file exists and is valid for the given ONNX file.
   494	     *
   495	     * @param onnxFilePath absolute path to the ONNX model file
   496	     * @return true if a valid cache exists
   497	     */
   498	    public static boolean isCached(String onnxFilePath) {
   499	        File onnxFile = new File(onnxFilePath);
   500	        File sdzFile = getSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);
   501	        return sdzFile.exists() && sdzFile.lastModified() >= onnxFile.lastModified();
   502	    }
   503	
   504	    /**
   505	     * Get the SDZ cache file path for a given ONNX file.
   506	     * The SDZ file is placed alongside the ONNX file with the same base name.
   507	     */
   508	    private static File getSdzCacheFile(File onnxFile) {
   509	        String name = onnxFile.getName();
   510	        String baseName;
   511	        int dotIdx = name.lastIndexOf('.');
   512	        if (dotIdx > 0) {
   513	            baseName = name.substring(0, dotIdx);
   514	        } else {
   515	            baseName = name;
   516	        }
   517	        return new File(onnxFile.getParentFile(), baseName + ".sdz");
   518	    }
   519	
   520	    /**
   521	     * Get the optimized SDZ cache file path for a given ONNX file.
   522	     */
   523	    private static File getOptimizedSdzCacheFile(File onnxFile) {
   524	        String name = onnxFile.getName();
   525	        String baseName;
   526	        int dotIdx = name.lastIndexOf('.');
   527	        if (dotIdx > 0) {
   528	            baseName = name.substring(0, dotIdx);
   529	        } else {
   530	            baseName = name;
   531	        }
   532	        return new File(onnxFile.getParentFile(), baseName + ".opt.sdz");
   533	    }
   534	}

   221	                                                   ValidateFunction validateFn,

   226	        log.info("Running {} configurations:", filtered.size());

   403	    private static boolean expectsGraphCapture(BenchmarkConfig config) {
   404	        // When shape freezing is disabled via system property, graph capture cannot happen
   405	        // regardless of config flags (shapes must be frozen for CUDA graph capture)
   406	        boolean freezeDisabled = "true".equalsIgnoreCase(System.getProperty("nd4j.dsp.nofreeze"));
   407	        boolean directDisabled = "true".equalsIgnoreCase(System.getProperty("nd4j.dsp.noDirect"));
   408	        if (freezeDisabled || directDisabled) {
   409	            return false;
   410	        }
   411	        return config.isTritonGraphCapture() || config.getExecutionMode() == GraphExecutionMode.CUDA_GRAPHS;
   412	    }

   414	    private static String resolveModelLabel(List<String> modelNames, int index) {
   415	        if (modelNames != null && index < modelNames.size()) {
   416	            String label = modelNames.get(index);
   417	            if (label != null && !label.isEmpty()) {
   418	                return label;
   419	            }
   420	        }
   421	        return "model" + index;
   422	    }

    73	        try {
    74	            // Create realistic matmul inputs (like a decoder layer)
    75	            // [1, 2048] x [2048, 2048] — typical hidden→hidden projection
    76	            INDArray a = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 2048);
    77	            INDArray b = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 2048, 2048);
    78	
    79	            // TF32 OFF (IEEE FP32)
    80	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(false);
    81	            INDArray resultIeee = a.mmul(b);
    82	
    83	            // TF32 ON (reduced precision tensor cores)
    84	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(true);
    85	            INDArray resultTf32 = a.mmul(b);
    86	
    87	            // They should be close but may differ
    88	            double maxDiff = resultIeee.sub(resultTf32).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
    89	            System.out.println("Max absolute difference (TF32 vs IEEE): " + maxDiff);
    90	
    91	            // TF32 has 10-bit mantissa vs 23-bit for FP32.
    92	            // For a 2048-wide dot product, error can compound.
    93	            // Just verify both produce valid (non-NaN, non-Inf) results.
    94	            assertFalse(resultIeee.isNaN().any(), "IEEE result has NaN");
    95	            assertFalse(resultTf32.isNaN().any(), "TF32 result has NaN");
    96	            assertFalse(resultIeee.isInfinite().any(), "IEEE result has Inf");
    97	            assertFalse(resultTf32.isInfinite().any(), "TF32 result has Inf");
    98	        } finally {
    99	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(original);
   100	        }
   101	    }

   103	    @Test
   104	    @DisplayName("Chained matmuls with TF32 should not diverge catastrophically over 30 layers")
   105	    public void testChainedMatmulTf32Divergence() {
   106	        var env = Nd4j.getEnvironment();
   107	        boolean original = env.cublasTf32Enabled();
   108	        try {
   109	            // Simulate 30 transformer layers: x = x @ W for each layer
   110	            int hidden = 2048;
   111	            INDArray x = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, hidden).mul(0.01);
   112	
   113	            // Generate 30 weight matrices (shared between TF32 and IEEE runs)
   114	            INDArray[] weights = new INDArray[30];
   115	            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   116	                weights[i] = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, hidden, hidden).mul(0.02);
   117	            }
   118	
   119	            // IEEE run
   120	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(false);
   121	            INDArray xIeee = x.dup();
   122	            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   123	                xIeee = xIeee.mmul(weights[i]);
   124	            }
   125	
   126	            // TF32 run
   127	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(true);
   128	            INDArray xTf32 = x.dup();
   129	            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   130	                xTf32 = xTf32.mmul(weights[i]);
   131	            }
   132	
   133	            double maxDiff = xIeee.sub(xTf32).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   134	            double ieeeMax = xIeee.amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   135	            double relDiff = ieeeMax > 0 ? maxDiff / ieeeMax : maxDiff;
   136	
   137	            System.out.println("After 30 chained matmuls:");
   138	            System.out.println("  IEEE max abs: " + ieeeMax);
   139	            System.out.println("  TF32 max abs: " + xTf32.amaxNumber().doubleValue());
   140	            System.out.println("  Max absolute diff: " + maxDiff);
   141	            System.out.println("  Relative diff: " + relDiff);
   142	
   143	            // Both should still be valid
   144	            assertFalse(xIeee.isNaN().any(), "IEEE result has NaN after 30 layers");
   145	            assertFalse(xTf32.isNaN().any(), "TF32 result has NaN after 30 layers");
   146	        } finally {
   147	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(original);
   148	        }
   149	    }

   153	    @Test
   154	    @DisplayName("putScalar on FLOAT array followed by ensureLocation(DEVICE) should be visible")
   155	    public void testPutScalarEnsureLocationVisibility() {
   156	        // Simulates the attn_mask_reformat bias update pattern:
   157	        //   bias.putScalar({0,0,0,pos}, 0.0f);
   158	        //   ensureLocation(bias, DEVICE);
   159	        // If ensureLocation doesn't actually trigger H2D, the device buffer is stale.
   160	        INDArray bias = Nd4j.valueArrayOf(new long[]{1, 1, 1, 100}, MASK_FILL, DataType.FLOAT);
   161	        Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(bias,
   162	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   163	
   164	        // Unmask positions one at a time (simulating decode steps)
   165	        for (int pos = 0; pos < 50; pos++) {
   166	            bias.putScalar(new long[]{0, 0, 0, pos}, 0.0f);
   167	            Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(bias,
   168	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   169	        }
   170	
   171	        // Read back and verify all 50 positions are unmasked
   172	        for (int pos = 0; pos < 50; pos++) {
   173	            float val = bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, pos);
   174	            assertEquals(0.0f, val, 1e-6f,
   175	                    "Position " + pos + " should be unmasked (0.0) but got " + val);
   176	        }
   177	        // Verify remaining positions still masked
   178	        for (int pos = 50; pos < 100; pos++) {
   179	            float val = bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, pos);
   180	            assertEquals(MASK_FILL, val, 1e-6f,
   181	                    "Position " + pos + " should still be masked");
   182	        }
   183	    }

   185	    @Test
   186	    @DisplayName("putScalar on LONG array (attention_mask) followed by ensureLocation(DEVICE)")
   187	    public void testLongMaskPutScalarVisibility() {
   188	        // Simulates 1D attention mask update pattern
   189	        long maxKvLen = 729;
   190	        long currentSeqLen = 1;
   191	        long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + currentSeqLen;
   192	
   193	        INDArray mask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, totalSeqLen);
   194	        // Set prefill positions
   195	        int prefillLen = 679;
   196	        mask.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   197	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, prefillLen)).assign(1);
   198	        mask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1);
   199	
   200	        Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(mask,
   201	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   202	
   203	        // Simulate 20 decode steps — each unmasks one more position
   204	        for (int step = 0; step < 20; step++) {
   205	            long cachePos = prefillLen + step;
   206	            if (cachePos > 0) {
   207	                mask.put(new org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.INDArrayIndex[]{
   208	                                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   209	                                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(cachePos)},
   210	                        Nd4j.scalar(DataType.LONG, 1));
   211	                Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(mask,
   212	                        org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   213	            }
   214	        }
   215	
   216	        // Verify: positions 0..prefillLen+19 should be 1, the rest 0 (except last)
   217	        long expectedOnes = prefillLen + 20 + 1; // prefill + 20 decode steps + last position
   218	        long actualSum = mask.sumNumber().longValue();
   219	        assertEquals(expectedOnes, actualSum,
   220	                "Expected " + expectedOnes + " ones in mask but got " + actualSum);
   221	    }

   224	
   225	    @Test
   226	    @DisplayName("4D bias initial construction should mask exactly [cachePos..maxKvLen-1]")
   227	    public void testBiasInitialConstruction() {
   228	        long maxKvLen = 729;
   229	        long currentSeqLen = 1;
   230	        long cachePos = 679; // prefillSeqLen
   231	        long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + currentSeqLen; // 730
   232	
   233	        int totalLen = (int) totalSeqLen;
   234	        float[] biasData = new float[(int) currentSeqLen * totalLen];
   235	        for (int q = 0; q < (int) currentSeqLen; q++) {
   236	            int rowOffset = q * totalLen;
   237	            for (int k = (int) cachePos; k < (int) maxKvLen; k++) {
   238	                biasData[rowOffset + k] = MASK_FILL;
   239	            }
   240	            for (int k = q + 1; k < (int) currentSeqLen; k++) {
   241	                biasData[rowOffset + (int) maxKvLen + k] = MASK_FILL;
   242	            }
   243	        }
   244	
   245	        INDArray bias = Nd4j.create(biasData, new long[]{1, 1, currentSeqLen, totalLen}, 'c');
   246	
   247	        // Positions [0..678] should be 0.0 (attend to prefill)
   248	        for (int k = 0; k < cachePos; k++) {
   249	            assertEquals(0.0f, bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, k), 1e-6f,
   250	                    "Position " + k + " (prefill) should be 0.0 (attend)");
   251	        }
   252	        // Positions [679..728] should be MASK_FILL (empty padding)
   253	        for (int k = (int) cachePos; k < (int) maxKvLen; k++) {
   254	            assertEquals(MASK_FILL, bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, k), 1e-6f,
   255	                    "Position " + k + " (empty) should be MASK_FILL");
   256	        }
   257	        // Position 729 (current token) should be 0.0 (attend)
   258	        assertEquals(0.0f, bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, (int) maxKvLen), 1e-6f,
   259	                "Position " + maxKvLen + " (current token) should be 0.0");
   260	    }

   262	    @Test
   263	    @DisplayName("Bias accumulation over 50 steps should unmask exactly one position per step")
   264	    public void testBiasAccumulationOver50Steps() {
   265	        long maxKvLen = 729;
   266	        long currentSeqLen = 1;
   267	        long prefillSeqLen = 679;
   268	        long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + currentSeqLen;
   269	
   270	        // Build initial bias (step 1 creation)
   271	        int totalLen = (int) totalSeqLen;
   272	        float[] biasData = new float[totalLen];
   273	        for (int k = (int) prefillSeqLen; k < (int) maxKvLen; k++) {
   274	            biasData[k] = MASK_FILL;
   275	        }
   276	        INDArray bias = Nd4j.create(biasData, new long[]{1, 1, 1, totalLen}, 'c');
   277	
   278	        // Simulate 50 decode steps
   279	        for (int step = 0; step < 50; step++) {
   280	            long cachePos = prefillSeqLen + 1 + step; // after step 1 scatter
   281	            if (cachePos > 0) {
   282	                bias.putScalar(new long[]{0, 0, 0, cachePos - 1}, 0.0f);
   283	            }
   284	
   285	            // Count unmasked positions in the past region [0..maxKvLen-1]
   286	            int unmasked = 0;
   287	            for (int k = 0; k < (int) maxKvLen; k++) {
   288	                if (Math.abs(bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, k)) < 1e-6f) {
   289	                    unmasked++;
   290	                }
   291	            }
   292	            int expected = (int) prefillSeqLen + step + 1; // prefill + steps unmasked so far
   293	            assertEquals(expected, unmasked,
   294	                    "At step " + step + ": expected " + expected + " unmasked positions, got " + unmasked);
   295	        }
   296	    }

   137	bool segmentHasStablePointersForPlanPhase(const GraphSegment& seg, NativeSlot* slots) {
   138	  if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) return true;
   139	  const bool needsReplayInvariantTracking = segmentHasInternalValueShapeInputs(seg, slots);
   140	
   141	  switch (seg.def.selectedBackend) {
   142	    case SelectedBackend::EMULATED_REPLAY:
   143	      return seg.exec.argTableStable;
   144	
   145	    case SelectedBackend::CPU_GRAPH:
   146	      return seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING ||
   147	             segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 1);
   148	
   149	    case SelectedBackend::GPU_COMPILER:
   150	      if (seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING) {
   151	        const bool expectsReplayHandle =
   152	            seg.exec.replayHandle != nullptr || seg.exec.compiledByBackend == "Triton GPU";
   153	        if (!expectsReplayHandle) return true;
   154	        return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady() &&
   155	               (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   156	      }
   157	      if (seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady()) {
   158	        return !needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable;
   159	      }
   160	      return segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 1) &&
   161	             (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   162	
   163	    case SelectedBackend::CUDA_GRAPHS:
   164	    case SelectedBackend::SLOT_BY_SLOT:
   165	      return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady();
   166	  }
   167	
   168	  return false;
   169	}

   171	bool segmentIsFullyReplayingForPlanPhase(const GraphSegment& seg, NativeSlot* slots) {
   172	  if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) return true;
   173	  const bool needsReplayInvariantTracking = segmentHasInternalValueShapeInputs(seg, slots);
   174	
   175	  switch (seg.def.selectedBackend) {
   176	    case SelectedBackend::EMULATED_REPLAY:
   177	      return seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING &&
   178	             seg.exec.argTableStable;
   179	
   180	    case SelectedBackend::CPU_GRAPH:
   181	      return seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING ||
   182	             segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 2);
   183	
   184	    case SelectedBackend::GPU_COMPILER:
   185	      if (seg.exec.replayHandle) {
   186	        return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady() &&
   187	               seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING &&
   188	               (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   189	      }
   190	      if (seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING &&
   191	          seg.exec.compiledByBackend == "Triton GPU") {
   192	        return false;
   193	      }
   194	      if (seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING) {
   195	        return !needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable;
   196	      }
   197	      return segmentIsCompiledSteadyState(seg, 2) &&
   198	             (!needsReplayInvariantTracking || seg.exec.argTableStable);
   199	
   200	    case SelectedBackend::CUDA_GRAPHS:
   201	    case SelectedBackend::SLOT_BY_SLOT:
   202	      return seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady() &&
   203	             seg.exec.currentPhase == ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING;
   204	  }
   205	
   206	  return false;
   207	}

   637	// Platform dispatch: Switch-based backend dispatch (no cascade)
   638	// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   639	
   640	Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::platformExecuteSegmentWithBackends(
   641	    GraphSegment& segment, NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs,
   642	    void* stream, bool& usedGraph) {
   643	  usedGraph = false;
   644	
   645	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "NativeDSP::execute: seg[%d-%d] selectedBackend=%d isCapturable=%d executionCount=%d phase=%d",
   646	           segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot,
   647	           static_cast<int>(segment.def.selectedBackend), static_cast<int>(segment.def.isCapturable),
   648	           segment.exec.executionCount, static_cast<int>(segment.exec.currentPhase));
   649	
   650	  switch (segment.def.selectedBackend) {
   651	    case SelectedBackend::GPU_COMPILER: {
   652	      auto* gpuBackend = getGpuGraphBackend();
   653	      if (gpuBackend) {
   654	        auto status = executeSegmentWithGpuGraph(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
   655	        if (status == Status::OK) {
   656	          usedGraph = true;
   657	          if (segment.exec.executionCount <= 1) {
   658	            segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::COMPILING;
   659	          } else if (segment.exec.replayHandle && segment.exec.replayHandle->isReady()) {
   660	            segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING;
   661	          } else {
   662	            segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::COMPILED;
   663	          }
   664	          return Status::OK;
   665	        }
   666	        // GPU backend failed — hard error. No cascade.
   667	        DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "NativeDSP::execute: exec%d seg[%d-%d] gpuBackend=%s FAILED status=%d — hard error",
   668	                 executeCount_, segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, gpuBackend->name(),
   669	                 static_cast<int>(status));
   670	        return status;
   671	      }
   672	      // GEM_AUTO resolved to GPU_COMPILER but no backend available at runtime.
   673	      // Fall through to CUDA graphs if enabled, otherwise slot-by-slot.
   674	      if (gpuGraphCaptureEnabled_) {
   675	        goto cuda_graphs;
   676	      }
   677	      goto slot_by_slot;
   678	    }
   679	
   680	    case SelectedBackend::CUDA_GRAPHS: {
   681	cuda_graphs:
   682	      auto status = executeSegmentWithGraph(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
   683	      if (status != Status::OK) {
   684	        DSP_DIAG(COMPILE, "NativeDSP::execute: CUDA graph capture FAILED for seg[%d-%d] status=%d — hard error",
   685	                 segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, static_cast<int>(status));
   686	        segment.exec.compilationFailed = true;
   687	        return status;
   688	      }
   689	      usedGraph = (segment.exec.replayHandle != nullptr && segment.exec.replayHandle->isReady() && !segment.exec.compilationFailed);
   690	      if (usedGraph) {
   691	        segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::REPLAYING;
   692	      } else if (segment.exec.executionCount <= 1) {
   693	        segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::COMPILING;
   694	      } else {
   695	        segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::COMPILED;
   696	      }
   697	      return Status::OK;
   698	    }
   699	
   700	    case SelectedBackend::SLOT_BY_SLOT:
   701	    default:
   702	slot_by_slot:
   703	      segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
   704	      return executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
   705	
   706	    case SelectedBackend::CPU_GRAPH:
   707	      // CPU graph backend not applicable on CUDA build — treat as slot-by-slot
   708	      segment.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
   709	      return executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
   710	  }
   711	}

   714	// Platform dispatch: Post-segment error check
   715	// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   716	
   717	Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::platformCheckPostSegment(GraphSegment& segment) {
   718	  auto lastErr = cudaGetLastError();
   719	  if (lastErr != cudaSuccess) {
   720	    char buf[512];
   721	    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "CUDA error after segment [%d-%d] (execCount=%d shapesFrozen=%d): %d (%s)",
   722	             segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot,
   723	             executeCount_, static_cast<int>(shapesFrozen_),
   724	             static_cast<int>(lastErr), cudaGetErrorString(lastErr));
   725	    DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "NativeDynamicShapePlan: %s", buf);

   431	    /**
   432	     * Scatter accepted KV entries from the last merged step into static buffers.
   433	     *
   434	     * After verification determines how many tokens were accepted, scatter those
   435	     * positions from the present KV outputs into the static KV cache.
   436	     *
   437	     * @param baseCachePos starting target position in static KV buffer
   438	     * @param numAccepted number of positions to scatter (accepted + 1 for correction)
   439	     */
   440	    public void scatterAcceptedKv(long baseCachePos, int numAccepted) {
   441	        if (lastOutputs == null || kvCacheManager == null) return;
   442	
   443	        // Set cache position so scatterMultipleEntries writes at the right offset
   444	        kvCacheManager.setCachePosition(baseCachePos);
   445	        kvCacheManager.scatterMultipleEntries(lastOutputs, kvNames, numAccepted);
   446	
   447	        // Close present KV outputs after scatter
   448	        closeLastKvOutputs();
   449	    }
   450	
   451	    /**
   452	     * Release references to present KV outputs from the last step.
   453	     *
   454	     * <p>In DSP mode, present KV outputs are views that share data buffers with
   455	     * the slot cache. Closing them would destroy the underlying buffers, causing
   456	     * "DataBuffer released via close()" errors on the next execution step.
   457	     * Instead, just release the references — the slot cache manages buffer lifetime.</p>
   458	     */
   459	    private void closeLastKvOutputs() {
   460	        if (lastOutputs == null) return;
   461	
   462	        // Don't close — these are views sharing buffers with the DSP slot cache.
   463	        // Just clear the references so they can be GC'd if not held elsewhere.
   464	        for (String pn : kvNames.keyNames) {
   465	            lastOutputs.remove(pn);
   466	        }
   467	        for (String pn : kvNames.valueNames) {
   468	            lastOutputs.remove(pn);
   469	        }
   470	    }

   472	    /**
   473	     * Update fixed-address input buffers with new data.
   474	     */
   475	    private void updateInputs(INDArray embeddings, INDArray inputIds, long cachePos) {
   476	        // Embeddings: [1, seqLen, hidden]
   477	        reusableEmbeddings.assign(embeddings);
   478	
   479	        // Input IDs: [1, seqLen]
   480	        reusableInputIds.assign(inputIds);
   481	
   482	        // Attention mask: [1, maxKvLen + seqLen]
   483	        // 1s at positions 0..cachePos-1 (past) + last seqLen positions (current tokens)
   484	        reusableAttentionMask.assign(0);
   485	        if (cachePos > 0) {
   486	            reusableAttentionMask.get(
   487	                    NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   488	                    NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePos)).assign(1);
   489	        }
   490	        // Current token positions at the end (the concat'd positions)
   491	        long maskLen = maxKvLen + seqLen;
   492	        reusableAttentionMask.get(
   493	                NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   494	                NDArrayIndex.interval(maskLen - seqLen, maskLen)).assign(1);
   495	
   496	        // Position IDs: [1, seqLen] — consecutive from cachePos
   497	        for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
   498	            reusablePositionIds.putScalar(0, i, cachePos + i);
   499	        }
   500	
   501	        // 4D attention bias: [1, 1, seqLen, maxKvLen + seqLen]
   502	        // Directly provides the attention mask to onnx_multi_head_attention,
   503	        // bypassing the attn_mask_reformat subgraph.
   504	        // Layout: past positions [0..maxKvLen-1], current positions [maxKvLen..maxKvLen+seqLen-1]
   505	        //   - Past [0..cachePos-1]: 0 (valid past, attend freely)
   506	        //   - Past [cachePos..maxKvLen-1]: MASK_FILL (empty past padding, block)
   507	        //   - Current [maxKvLen+0..maxKvLen+q] for query q: 0 (causal, attend)
   508	        //   - Current [maxKvLen+q+1..maxKvLen+seqLen-1] for query q: MASK_FILL (future, block)
   509	        int totalLen = (int)(maxKvLen + seqLen);
   510	        float[] biasData = new float[seqLen * totalLen];
   511	        for (int q = 0; q < seqLen; q++) {
   512	            int rowOffset = q * totalLen;
   513	            // Past positions: valid up to cachePos, masked after
   514	            for (int k = (int)cachePos; k < (int)maxKvLen; k++) {
   515	                biasData[rowOffset + k] = DecoderUtils.MASK_FILL;
   516	            }
   517	            // Current positions: causal — future tokens masked
   518	            for (int k = q + 1; k < seqLen; k++) {
   519	                biasData[rowOffset + (int)maxKvLen + k] = DecoderUtils.MASK_FILL;
   520	            }
   521	        }
   522	
   523	        INDArray newBias = Nd4j.create(biasData, new long[]{1, 1, seqLen, totalLen}, 'c');
   524	        reusableAttnBias.assign(newBias);
   525	        newBias.close();
   526	    }

   437	            String pastName = kvName.replace("present", "past_key_values");
   438	            INDArray kv = prefillResult.get(kvName);
   439	            long[] shape = kv.shape(); // [1, heads, seqLen, dim]
   440	            INDArray padded = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, shape[0], shape[1], maxKvLen, shape[3]);
   441	            padded.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   442	                    NDArrayIndex.interval(0, shape[2]), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(kv);
   443	            staticKv.put(pastName, padded);
   444	        }
   445	
   446	        // === STEP 1: Manual path (growing KV, all-ones mask) ===
   447	        resetDecoder();
   448	        INDArray tokenEmbed = embeddingTable.getRow(firstToken).reshape(1, 1, hiddenSize);

   450	        for (String name : decoder.inputs()) {

   452	            else if (name.equals("attention_mask")) manualInputs.put(name, Nd4j.ones(DataType.LONG, 1, seqLen + 1));
   453	            else if (name.equals("position_ids")) manualInputs.put(name, Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[]{seqLen}).reshape(1, 1));
   454	            else if (name.startsWith("past_key_values.") && manualKv.containsKey(name)) manualInputs.put(name, manualKv.get(name));
   455	        }

   465	        sparseMask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.interval(0, seqLen)).assign(1);
   466	        sparseMask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1); // current token

codex
I’m checking one more important interaction: the decode loop doesn’t switch to `outputDirect()` until `step >= 2`, but it enables logits-only native KV retention immediately after prefill. If the first frozen decode executions still go through the slower `output()` path, that can be enough to stall replay promotion or hide a step-1/step-2 state mismatch. I want to confirm how `SameDiff.output()` vs `outputDirect()` actually routes through the native executor before I rank that hypothesis.

   318	    public DynamicShapePlan compileDynamicShapePlan(@NonNull List<String> requestedOutputs) {

   331	        return plan;

   407	    private void collectCloseableBuffers(SDValue value, IdentityHashMap<DataBuffer, Boolean> buffers) {
   408	        if (value == null) {
   409	            return;
   410	        }
   411	
   412	        switch (value.getSdValueType()) {
   413	            case TENSOR:
   414	                INDArray tensor = value.getTensorValue();
   415	                if (tensor != null && !tensor.wasClosed() && tensor.data() != null) {
   416	                    buffers.put(tensor.data(), Boolean.TRUE);
   417	                }
   418	                break;
   419	            case LIST:
   420	                if (value.getListValue() != null) {
   421	                    for (INDArray arr : value.getListValue()) {
   422	                        if (arr != null && !arr.wasClosed() && arr.data() != null) {
   423	                            buffers.put(arr.data(), Boolean.TRUE);
   424	                        }
   425	                    }
   426	                }
   427	                break;
   428	            case DICT:
   429	                if (value.getDictValue() != null) {
   430	                    for (INDArray arr : value.getDictValue().values()) {
   431	                        if (arr != null && !arr.wasClosed() && arr.data() != null) {
   432	                            buffers.put(arr.data(), Boolean.TRUE);
   433	                        }
   434	                    }
   435	                }
   436	                break;
   437	            default:
   438	                break;
   439	        }
   440	    }

   442	    private int closeLatestRequestedOutputBuffers() {
   443	        Map<String, SDValue> latestOutputs = latestRequestedOutputsTl.get();
   444	        if (latestOutputs == null || latestOutputs.isEmpty()) {
   445	            return 0;
   446	        }
   447	
   448	        IdentityHashMap<DataBuffer, Boolean> protectedBuffers = snapshotProtectedBuffersForCleanup();
   449	        IdentityHashMap<DataBuffer, Boolean> uniqueBuffers = new IdentityHashMap<>();
   450	        for (SDValue value : latestOutputs.values()) {
   451	            collectCloseableBuffers(value, uniqueBuffers);
   452	        }
   453	
   454	        int closed = 0;
   455	        for (DataBuffer buf : uniqueBuffers.keySet()) {
   456	            if (buf == null || protectedBuffers.containsKey(buf)) {

   469	        return closed;
   470	    }
