  1539	
  1540	        // Merge any remaining deferred buffers from mid-execution flushes.
  1541	        if (!deferredClose.isEmpty()) {
  1542	            pendingClose.addAll(deferredClose);
  1543	            deferredClose.clear();
  1544	        }
  1545	
  1546	        // Collect eligible buffers from the cache into pendingClose.
  1547	        // The persistent dedup sets (seenIdentity, closedOdbAddresses) from the previous
  1548	        // execute() call will correctly skip buffers already freed during execution.
  1549	        int collected = 0;
  1550	        for (int i = 0; i < slotArrayCache.length; i++) {
  1551	            INDArray arr = slotArrayCache[i];
  1552	            if (arr != null && !arr.wasClosed()) {
  1553	                DataBuffer buf = arr.data();
  1554	                if (buf != null && !buf.wasClosed()) {
  1555	                    // Undo setCloseable(false) poisoning from directExecHelper().
  1556	                    // Session intermediates are marked constant via setCloseable(false)
  1557	                    // → setConstant(true). Without undoing this, the slot cache cannot
  1558	                    // free ANY buffers during session reset, leaking all GPU memory.
  1559	                    if (buf.isConstant() && !buf.isAttached()) {
  1560	                        try {
  1561	                            buf.setConstant(false);
  1562	                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
  1563	                    }
  1564	                    if (!buf.isConstant()) {
  1565	                        pendingClose.add(buf);
  1566	                        collected++;
  1567	                    }
  1568	                }
  1569	            }
  1570	            slotArrayCache[i] = null;
  1571	        }
  1572	
  1573	        if (collected == 0) {
  1574	            log.info("    closeSlotArrayCache: nothing to free");
  1575	            return;
  1576	        }
  1577	
  1578	        log.info("    closeSlotArrayCache: collected {} buffers, calling freePendingBuffers", collected);
  1579	        System.out.flush(); System.err.flush();
  1580	
  1581	        NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
  1582	        Pointer stream = DeviceMemoryManager.getInstance().getFreshExecutionStream();
  1583	
  1584	        // Sync execution stream so all GPU kernels using these buffers have completed.
  1585	        Nd4j.getExecutioner().commit();
  1586	
  1587	        // Free with full dedup. liveGpuAddresses=null because no slots are live during close().
  1588	        int[] stats = freePendingBuffers(nativeOps, stream, null);
  1589	        pendingClose.clear();
  1590	
  1591	        log.info("    closeSlotArrayCache: freePendingBuffers done ({}/{} freed, {}MB)", stats[0], stats[1], stats[2]);
  1592	        System.out.flush(); System.err.flush();
  1593	
  1594	        // Trim memory pool so freed memory is immediately available
  1595	        if (stream != null) {
  1596	            int currentDevice = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread();
  1597	            nativeOps.trimMemoryPoolOnStream(currentDevice, stream);
  1598	            // Cross-device frees use stream 0 on target device — sync that stream
  1599	            for (int d = 0; d < cachedNumDevices; d++) {
  1600	                if (d != currentDevice) {
  1601	                    nativeOps.trimMemoryPoolOnStream(d, null);
  1602	                }
  1603	            }
  1604	        }
  1605	        log.info("    closeSlotArrayCache: DONE");
  1606	        System.out.flush(); System.err.flush();
  1607	    }
  1608	
  1609	    /**
  1610	     * Release all GPU memory held by intermediate computation results on the C++ native
  1611	     * plan, while keeping the plan handle alive for reuse. This frees:
  1612	     * <ul>
  1613	     *   <li>Non-weight NDArrays from output slots (SLOT_OWNED buffers)</li>
  1614	     *   <li>Per-segment CUDA graph replay handles (workspaces, host pointers)</li>
  1615	     *   <li>cuBLAS workspace (~256 MB)</li>
  1616	     *   <li>Batch-zero, batch-D2D, and batched-GEMM device arrays</li>
  1617	     *   <li>MmulHelper cast cache (thread-local FP16-to-FP32 staging)</li>
  1618	     * </ul>
  1619	     *
  1620	     * <p>After this call the plan is in a "cold" state — the next {@code execute()} will
  1621	     * re-warm (re-detect view producers, re-capture CUDA graphs, re-allocate workspace, etc.)
  1622	     * just like the very first execution after compilation.</p>
  1623	     *
  1624	     * <p>Use this between VLM decode runs to reclaim GPU memory (~14 GB for large models)
  1625	     * without the cost of plan re-compilation.</p>
  1626	     *
  1627	     * <p>Also clears the Java-side slot array cache and trims the CUDA memory pool.</p>
  1628	     *
  1629	     * @return the number of intermediate NDArrays freed on the C++ side, or 0 if no
  1630	     *         native plan is compiled
  1631	     */
  1632	    public int releaseGpuIntermediates() {
  1633	        return releaseGpuIntermediates(false);
  1634	    }
  1635	
  1636	    /**
  1637	     * Release GPU intermediates with option to preserve decode-invariant state.
  1638	     *
  1639	     * @param preserveDecodeState  If true, preserves:
  1640	     *   <ul>
  1641	     *     <li>output slot arrays (decode has invariant shapes)</li>
  1642	     *     <li>CUDA graph replay handles (same kernel graph for decode)</li>
  1643	     *     <li>cuBLAS workspace (same GEMM shapes for decode)</li>
  1644	     *     <li>Batch-zero, batch-D2D, batched-GEMM device arrays</li>
  1645	     *   </ul>
  1646	     *   Only resets:
  1647	     *   <ul>
  1648	     *     <li>KV cache position (kvCachePosition_)</li>
  1649	     *     <li>Decode input pending updates (hasPendingDecodeUpdate_)</li>
  1650	     *   </ul>
  1651	     *
  1652	     * <p>Use this between VLM pages when decode shapes are invariant.</p>
  1653	     *
  1654	     * @return the number of intermediate NDArrays freed (0 if preserveDecodeState=true)
  1655	     */
  1656	    public int releaseGpuIntermediates(boolean preserveDecodeState) {
  1657	        if (preserveDecodeState) {
  1658	            log.info("releaseGpuIntermediates(preserve=true): preserving decode-invariant state");
  1659	            
  1660	            // Reset KV cache position for next page
  1661	            if (nativePlanHandle != null && !nativePlanHandle.isNull()) {
  1662	                NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
  1663	                nativeOps.releaseGpuIntermediates(nativePlanHandle, true);
  1664	            }
  1665	            
  1666	            // Reset Java-side KV cache state
  1667	            savedKvPresentOutputNames = null;
  1668	            savedKvPastInputNames = null;
  1669	            savedKvMaxLen = 0;
  1670	            savedKvCurrentPos = 0;
  1671	            kvCacheRetentionConfigured = false;
  1672	            kvRetentionOutputNames = null;
  1673	            
  1674	            // Clear pending decode update state
  1675	            // (decodeInputsConfigured remains true - still valid for next page)
  1676	            
  1677	            log.info("releaseGpuIntermediates(preserve=true): DONE - no GPU memory freed");
  1678	            return 0;
  1679	        }
  1680	        
  1681	        // Full release path
  1682	        log.info("releaseGpuIntermediates: START");
  1683	        System.out.flush(); System.err.flush();
  1684	
  1685	        // Step 1: Clear Java-side slot array cache (frees Java-managed DataBuffers)
  1686	        closeSlotArrayCache();
  1687	
  1688	        // Step 2: Call C++ releaseGpuIntermediates (frees CUDA graphs, replay workspaces,
  1689	        //         cuBLAS workspace, and non-weight output slot NDArrays)
  1690	        int freedCount = 0;
  1691	        if (nativePlanHandle != null && !nativePlanHandle.isNull()) {
  1692	            NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
  1693	            freedCount = nativeOps.releaseGpuIntermediates(nativePlanHandle);
  1694	            log.info("releaseGpuIntermediates: C++ freed {} intermediate arrays", freedCount);
  1695	
  1696	            // Step 3: Trim CUDA memory pool so freed memory is returned to CUDA
  1697	            Pointer stream = DeviceMemoryManager.getInstance().getFreshExecutionStream();
  1698	            if (stream != null) {
  1699	                int currentDevice = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getDeviceForCurrentThread();
  1700	                nativeOps.trimMemoryPoolOnStream(currentDevice, stream);
  1701	                int numDevices = Nd4j.getAffinityManager().getNumberOfDevices();
  1702	                for (int d = 0; d < numDevices; d++) {
  1703	                    if (d != currentDevice) {
  1704	                        nativeOps.trimMemoryPoolOnStream(d, null);
  1705	                    }
  1706	                }
  1707	            }
  1708	        } else {
  1709	            log.info("releaseGpuIntermediates: no native plan handle, skipping C++ release");
  1710	        }
  1711	
  1712	        // Step 4: Reset Java-side execution state for re-warming
  1713	        frozenOutputsInitialized = false;
  1714	        frozenCallCount = 0;
  1715	        closeZeroCopyOutputCache();
  1716	
  1717	        log.info("releaseGpuIntermediates: DONE (freed {} C++ arrays)", freedCount);
  1718	        System.out.flush(); System.err.flush();
  1719	        return freedCount;
  1720	    }
  1721	
  1722	    /**
  1723	     * Execute the plan entirely in C++ via a single JNI call.
  1724	     *
  1725	     * <p>Requires a previously compiled native plan handle (via {@link #compileNativePlan(DynamicShapePlan, GraphExecutionMode, boolean)}
  1726	     * or session-level auto-compile). External inputs are resolved and passed as OpaqueNDArray pointers.
  1727	     * C++ handles shape inference, memory allocation, op execution, and release scheduling internally.</p>
  1728	     *
  1729	     * @return output map if native execution succeeded, or null if native execution
  1730	     *         is not available (e.g., backend doesn't support it)
  1731	     * @throws RuntimeException if native execution fails (caller should fall back to Java)
  1732	     */
  1733	    private Map<String, INDArray> executeNative(DynamicShapePlan plan, Map<String, INDArray> placeholderArrays) {
  1734	        NativeOps nativeOps = NativeOpsHolder.getInstance().getDeviceNativeOps();
  1735	
  1736	        // Pin thread to the plan's execution device at the VERY START, before any
  1737	        // input resolution or array allocation. Without this, ops that ran between
  1738	        // decode steps (token sampling, embedding) can leave the thread on a different
  1739	        // device, causing Nd4j.create* / arange / scalar calls during input resolution
  1740	        // to allocate arrays on the wrong GPU. On non-peer multi-GPU systems, those
  1741	        // wrong-device arrays then require cross-device migration which can produce
  1742	        // stale pointers and CUDA error 700.
  1743	        if (nativeExecutionDevice >= 0) {
  1744	            int currentDevice = DeviceMemoryManager.getInstance().getCurrentDeviceId();
  1745	            if (currentDevice != nativeExecutionDevice) {
  1746	                DeviceMemoryManager.getInstance().switchDevice(nativeExecutionDevice,
  1747	                        "DSP.executeNative", "pin-to-plan-device");
  1748	            }
  1749	        }
  1750	
  1751	        // Native plan compilation is explicit (or controlled by InferenceSession auto-compile).
  1752	        if (!isNativePlanCompiled(plan)) {
  1753	            throw new RuntimeException("Native executor: plan not precompiled for native execution. " +
  1754	                    "Ensure compileNativePlan() is called before executeNative().");
  1755	        }
  1756	
  1757	        DspDiagnostics.record(DspDiagnostics.EXECUTE,
  1758	                "Java: executeNative ENTER executionCount=" + executionCount +
  1759	                " frozen=" + shapesFrozen + " slots=" + plan.getSlots().length);
  1760	
  1761	         // Resolve external inputs (constants, variables, placeholders)
  1762	        // When frozen, cache constant/variable arrays and only re-resolve placeholders
  1763	        String[] extKeys = plan.getExternalInputKeys();
  1764	        // Debug: identify external input 1331 (slot -1332) for H2D sync diagnostics
  1765	        if (Nd4j.getEnvironment().isDebug() && extKeys.length > 1331) {
  1766	            log.info("EXT_INPUT_1331: name='{}' total={}", extKeys[1331], extKeys.length);
  1767	        }
  1768	        INDArray[] extInputs;
  1769	        // Track indices of stale non-placeholder inputs refreshed in the fast path.
  1770	        // Declared here (outer scope) so the frozen fast path can access them.
  1771	        int[] staleNonPlaceholderIndices = null;
  1772	        int staleNonPlaceholderCount = 0;
  1773	        if (shapesFrozen && cachedInputArrays != null && cachedInputArrays.length == extKeys.length) {
  1774	            DspDiagnostics.record(DspDiagnostics.EXECUTE,
  1775	                    "Java: external inputs FAST PATH (frozen, " + extKeys.length + " cached)");
  1776	            // Fast path: reuse cached constant/variable arrays, only re-resolve placeholders.
  1777	            // Use a separate array so we don't corrupt cachedInputArrays (needed for identity comparison).
  1778	            extInputs = new INDArray[extKeys.length];
  1779	            System.arraycopy(cachedInputArrays, 0, extInputs, 0, extKeys.length);
  1780	            // Re-resolve any inputs whose DataBuffer has been freed between steps.
  1781	            // This can happen when setCloseable(true)+close() is called on KV outputs
  1782	            // that share a DataBuffer with past_key_values inputs, or when deferred
  1783	            // close evicts constant DataBuffers during long Triton compilations.
  1784	            int staleCount = 0;
  1785	            int resolvedCount = 0;
  1786	            int staleConstantCount = 0;
  1787	            int stalePlaceholderCount = 0;
  1788	            int staleOtherCount = 0;
  1789	            for (int i = 0; i < extKeys.length; i++) {
  1790	                if (extInputs[i] != null) {
  1791	                    DataBuffer db = extInputs[i].data();
  1792	                    if (db == null || db.wasClosed()) {
  1793	                        staleCount++;
  1794	                        SDVariable var = sd.getVariable(extKeys[i]);
  1795	                        VariableType vt = var != null ? var.getVariableType() : null;
  1796	                        if (var != null && (vt == VariableType.CONSTANT
  1797	                                || vt == VariableType.VARIABLE)) {
  1798	                            staleConstantCount++;
  1799	                            INDArray fresh = var.getArr();
  1800	                            if (fresh != null && fresh.data() != null && !fresh.data().wasClosed()) {
  1801	                                extInputs[i] = fresh;
  1802	                                cachedInputArrays[i] = fresh;
  1803	                                // Track for frozen fast path — must call setGraphContextInputArray
  1804	                                if (staleNonPlaceholderIndices == null) staleNonPlaceholderIndices = new int[16];
  1805	                                if (staleNonPlaceholderCount >= staleNonPlaceholderIndices.length)
  1806	                                    staleNonPlaceholderIndices = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(staleNonPlaceholderIndices, staleNonPlaceholderIndices.length * 2);
  1807	                                staleNonPlaceholderIndices[staleNonPlaceholderCount++] = i;
  1808	                                resolvedCount++;
  1809	                            } else {
  1810	                                // Dead constant: try to restore from cached values
  1811	                                INDArray cached = cachedConstantValues != null ? cachedConstantValues.get(i) : null;
  1812	                                if (cached != null && cached.data() != null && !cached.data().wasClosed()) {
  1813	                                    extInputs[i] = cached;
  1814	                                    cachedInputArrays[i] = cached;
  1815	                                    if (staleNonPlaceholderIndices == null) staleNonPlaceholderIndices = new int[16];
  1816	                                    if (staleNonPlaceholderCount >= staleNonPlaceholderIndices.length)
  1817	                                        staleNonPlaceholderIndices = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(staleNonPlaceholderIndices, staleNonPlaceholderIndices.length * 2);
  1818	                                    staleNonPlaceholderIndices[staleNonPlaceholderCount++] = i;
  1819	                                }
  1820	                                resolvedCount++;
  1821	                            }
  1822	                        } else if (vt == VariableType.PLACEHOLDER && placeholderArrays != null) {
  1823	                            stalePlaceholderCount++;
  1824	                            // Placeholder: re-resolve from placeholderArrays map
  1825	                            INDArray ph = placeholderArrays.get(extKeys[i]);
  1826	                            if (ph != null && ph.data() != null && !ph.data().wasClosed()) {
  1827	                                extInputs[i] = ph;
  1828	                                // DON'T update cachedInputArrays here — let the fast path
  1829	                                // detect the change (extInputs[i] != cachedInputArrays[i])
  1830	                                // and call setGraphContextInputArray to update C++ side.
  1831	                                resolvedCount++;
  1832	                            } else {
  1833	                                DspDiagnostics.record(DspDiagnostics.FALLBACK,
  1834	                                    "Java: ext[" + i + "] '" + extKeys[i] + "' type=PLACEHOLDER" +
  1835	                                    " STALE, placeholder not available in map");
  1836	                            }
  1837	                        } else {
  1838	                            staleOtherCount++;
  1839	                            DspDiagnostics.record(DspDiagnostics.FALLBACK,
  1840	                                "Java: ext[" + i + "] '" + extKeys[i] + "' type=" + vt +
  1841	                                " STALE but not CONST/VAR/PLACEHOLDER — cannot re-resolve!");
  1842	                        }
  1843	                    }
  1844	                }
  1845	            }
  1846	            if (staleCount > 0) {
  1847	                DspDiagnostics.record(DspDiagnostics.MEMORY,
  1848	                    "Java: external inputs fast path: " + staleCount + " stale, " +
  1849	                    resolvedCount + " resolved, " + (staleCount - resolvedCount) + " unresolvable");
  1850	                log.info("STALE_BUFFER_SCAN: total={} constants={} placeholders={} other={} resolved={}",
  1851	                        staleCount, staleConstantCount, stalePlaceholderCount, staleOtherCount, resolvedCount);
  1852	            }
  1853	            if (placeholderArrays != null && !placeholderArrays.isEmpty()
  1854	                    && inputIsPlaceholder != null) {
  1855	                for (int i = 0; i < extKeys.length; i++) {
  1856	                    if (inputIsPlaceholder[i]) {
  1857	                        INDArray ph = placeholderArrays.get(extKeys[i]);
  1858	                        if (ph != null) {
  1859	                            extInputs[i] = ph;
  1860	                        }
  1861	                    }
  1862	                }
  1863	            }
  1864	        } else {
  1865	            DspDiagnostics.record(DspDiagnostics.EXECUTE,
  1866	                    "Java: external inputs SLOW PATH (resolving " + extKeys.length + " inputs fresh)");
  1867	            extInputs = new INDArray[extKeys.length];
  1868	            if (cachedConstantValues == null) {
  1869	                cachedConstantValues = new HashMap<>();
  1870	            }
  1871	            int deadConstantCount = 0;
  1872	            int restoredFromCacheCount = 0;
  1873	            for (int i = 0; i < extKeys.length; i++) {
  1874	                String varName = extKeys[i];
  1875	                INDArray arr = null;
  1876	                if (placeholderArrays != null) {
  1877	                    arr = placeholderArrays.get(varName);
  1878	                }
  1879	                if (arr == null) {
  1880	                    SDVariable var = sd.getVariable(varName);
  1881	                    if (var != null &&
  1882	                            (var.getVariableType() == VariableType.CONSTANT ||
  1883	                                    var.getVariableType() == VariableType.VARIABLE ||
  1884	                                    var.getVariableType() == VariableType.ARRAY)) {
  1885	                        arr = var.getArr();
  1886	                        if (arr != null && (arr.data() == null || arr.data().wasClosed())) {
  1887	                            // DataBuffer closed by session cleanup. Restore from cache if available.
  1888	                            INDArray cached = cachedConstantValues.get(i);
  1889	                            if (cached != null && cached.data() != null && !cached.data().wasClosed()) {
  1890	                                arr = cached;
  1891	                                restoredFromCacheCount++;
  1892	                            } else {
  1893	                                // DataBuffer was closed but GPU memory may still be valid.
  1894	                                // For constants, pass the original array as-is — the native
  1895	                                // plan uses GPU pointers directly, and the GPU memory has not
  1896	                                // been freed (it's just marked "closed" on the Java side).
  1897	                                // Creating zeros here would corrupt model weights.
  1898	                                deadConstantCount++;
  1899	                                if (deadConstantCount <= 65) {
  1900	                                    log.warn("DEAD_CONSTANT_PASSTHROUGH: ext[{}] '{}' DataBuffer closed but passing original (dtype={}, shape={})",
  1901	                                             i, varName, arr.dataType(), Arrays.toString(arr.shape()));
  1902	                                }
  1903	                            }
  1904	                        } else if (arr != null && arr.data() != null && !arr.data().wasClosed()
  1905	                                   && var.getVariableType() == VariableType.CONSTANT
  1906	                                   && arr.length() <= 32 && !cachedConstantValues.containsKey(i)) {
  1907	                            // Buffer is alive — cache a detached copy for future recovery
  1908	                            cachedConstantValues.put(i, arr.dup());
  1909	                        }
  1910	                    }
  1911	                }
  1912	                if (arr == null) {
  1913	                    throw new RuntimeException("Native executor: missing external input '" + varName +
  1914	                            "' (index " + i + "/" + extKeys.length + "). " +
  1915	                            "All external inputs must be resolved. No fallback permitted.");
  1916	                }
  1917	                extInputs[i] = arr;
  1918	            }
  1919	            if (deadConstantCount > 0 || restoredFromCacheCount > 0) {
  1920	                log.info("DEAD_CONSTANT_SUMMARY: {} dead, {} restored from cache, {} total ext inputs",
  1921	                         deadConstantCount, restoredFromCacheCount, extKeys.length);
  1922	            }
  1923	        }
  1924	
  1925	        // Debug: dump external input 1331 value info for H2D sync diagnostics
  1926	        if (Nd4j.getEnvironment().isDebug() && extInputs.length > 1331 && extInputs[1331] != null) {
  1927	            INDArray ext1331 = extInputs[1331];
  1928	            log.info("EXT_INPUT_1331_VALUE: shape={} dtype={} sum={} max={} min={} isAttached={}",
  1929	                    java.util.Arrays.toString(ext1331.shape()),
  1930	                    ext1331.dataType(),
  1931	                    ext1331.length() <= 1000 ? ext1331.sumNumber() : "SKIPPED",
  1932	                    ext1331.length() <= 1000 ? ext1331.maxNumber() : "SKIPPED",
  1933	                    ext1331.length() <= 1000 ? ext1331.minNumber() : "SKIPPED",
  1934	                    ext1331.isAttached());
  1935	        }
  1936	
  1937	        // ATTN_DIAG + EXT_INPUT_WRITE diagnostics — only when debug is enabled
  1938	        if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
  1939	            for (int i = 0; i < extKeys.length; i++) {
  1940	                if (extKeys[i].contains("past_key_values")) {
  1941	                    INDArray arr = extInputs[i];
  1942	                    log.debug("ATTN_DIAG_JAVA: extIdx={} name='{}' rank={} shape={} empty={} length={} dtype={}",
  1943	                            i, extKeys[i],
  1944	                            arr != null ? arr.rank() : -1,
  1945	                            arr != null ? java.util.Arrays.toString(arr.shape()) : "null",
  1946	                            arr != null ? arr.isEmpty() : true,
  1947	                            arr != null ? arr.length() : 0,
  1948	                            arr != null ? arr.dataType() : "null");
  1949	                }
  1950	            }
  1951	
  1952	            int nullCount = 0, emptyCount = 0, dataCount = 0;
  1953	            for (int i = 0; i < extInputs.length; i++) {
  1954	                INDArray arr = extInputs[i];
  1955	                if (arr == null) {
  1956	                    nullCount++;
  1957	                    log.debug("EXT_INPUT_WRITE: idx={} name='{}' shape=null empty=true written=false", i, extKeys[i]);
  1958	                } else if (arr.isEmpty() || arr.length() == 0) {
  1959	                    emptyCount++;
  1960	                    log.debug("EXT_INPUT_WRITE: idx={} name='{}' shape={} empty=true written=false",
  1961	                            i, extKeys[i], java.util.Arrays.toString(arr.shape()));
  1962	                } else {
  1963	                    dataCount++;
  1964	                }
  1965	            }
  1966	            log.debug("EXT_INPUT_WRITE_SUMMARY: total={} null={} empty={} withData={}", extInputs.length, nullCount, emptyCount, dataCount);
  1967	        }
  1968	
  1969	        // GATHER DIAGNOSTIC: dump external inputs that are [1,1] INT64 (likely position_ids for gather slot 0)
  1970	        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(extInputs.length, 1333); i++) {
  1971	            INDArray arr = extInputs[i];
  1972	            if (arr != null && arr.rank() == 2 && arr.shape()[0] == 1 && arr.shape()[1] == 1
  1973	                    && arr.dataType() == DataType.INT64) {
  1974	                long val = arr.getInt(0);
  1975	                log.info("GATHER_DIAG: extIdx={} name='{}' shape=[1,1] INT64 value={} executionCount={}",
  1976	                        i, extKeys[i], val, executionCount);
  1977	            }
  1978	        }
  1979

  1981	        // MULTI-GPU DEVICE COHERENCY

    61	     * Build a causal attention mask for the decoder (FLOAT dtype).
    62	     *
    63	     * For prefill (currentSeqLen &gt; 1): upper-triangular mask filled with MASK_FILL
    64	     *   mask[q][k] = 0 if k &lt;= (pastSeqLen + q), else MASK_FILL
    65	     *
    66	     * For decode (currentSeqLen == 1): all zeros (single token attends to all past)
    67	     *
    68	     * Uses FLOAT (not LONG) because AddOp doesn't promote LONG-&gt;FLOAT correctly.
    69	     *
    70	     * @param currentSeqLen number of query tokens in this step
    71	     * @param totalSeqLen total KV length (past + current)
    72	     * @return INDArray of shape [1, 1, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen] with FLOAT dtype
    73	     */
    74	    public static INDArray buildCausalMask(long currentSeqLen, long totalSeqLen) {
    75	        return buildCausalMask(1, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen);
    76	    }

    78	    /**
    79	     * Build a batched causal attention mask for the decoder (FLOAT dtype).
    80	     *
    81	     * <p>For batch processing, all sequences share the same causal mask pattern
    82	     * (they all have the same sequence length at each step).</p>
    83	     *
    84	     * @param batchSize number of sequences in the batch
    85	     * @param currentSeqLen number of query tokens in this step
    86	     * @param totalSeqLen total KV length (past + current)
    87	     * @return INDArray of shape [batchSize, 1, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen] with FLOAT dtype
    88	     */
    89	    public static INDArray buildCausalMask(long batchSize, long currentSeqLen, long totalSeqLen) {
    90	        if (currentSeqLen == 1) {
    91	            return Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, batchSize, 1, 1, totalSeqLen);
    92	        }
    93	
    94	        long pastSeqLen = totalSeqLen - currentSeqLen;
    95	        int Q = (int) currentSeqLen;
    96	        int K = (int) totalSeqLen;
    97	        float[] data = new float[Q * K];
    98	
    99	        for (int q = 0; q < Q; q++) {
   100	            int lastVisibleK = (int) pastSeqLen + q;
   101	            int rowOffset = q * K;
   102	            for (int k = lastVisibleK + 1; k < K; k++) {
   103	                data[rowOffset + k] = MASK_FILL;
   104	            }
   105	        }
   106	
   107	        // Create single mask pattern
   108	        INDArray singleMask = Nd4j.create(data, new long[]{1, 1, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen}, 'c');
   109	
   110	        if (batchSize == 1) {
   111	            log.info("Built causal mask: shape=[1, 1, {}, {}], pastSeqLen={}, dtype=FLOAT",
   112	                    currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen, pastSeqLen);
   113	            return singleMask;
   114	        }
   115	
   116	        // Tile for batch dimension. Close singleMask after tiling since tile creates
   117	        // a new independent array and singleMask (a view of the 1D createFromArray result)
   118	        // would otherwise leak its underlying DataBuffer.
   119	        INDArray mask = Nd4j.tile(singleMask, (int) batchSize, 1, 1, 1);
   120	        singleMask.close();
   121	        log.info("Built batched causal mask: shape=[{}, 1, {}, {}], pastSeqLen={}, dtype=FLOAT",
   122	                batchSize, currentSeqLen, totalSeqLen, pastSeqLen);
   123	        return mask;
   124	    }

   236	     * @param decoder the SameDiff decoder model

   238	     */
   239	    public static String findLogitsOutputName(SameDiff decoder) {
   240	        for (String outputName : decoder.outputs()) {
   241	            if (outputName.contains("logit") || outputName.equals("logits")) {
   242	                return outputName;
   243	            }
   244	        }
   245	        if (!decoder.outputs().isEmpty()) {
   246	            return decoder.outputs().get(0);
   247	        }
   248	        return null;
   249	    }
   250	
   251	    /**
   252	     * Find the KV cache output names (present key/value) from a decoder model.
   253	     *
   254	     * @param decoder the SameDiff decoder model
   255	     * @return KVCacheNames with sorted key and value output names
   256	     */
   257	    public static KVCacheNames findKVCacheOutputNames(SameDiff decoder) {
   258	        List<String> presentKeyNames = new ArrayList<>();
   259	        List<String> presentValueNames = new ArrayList<>();
   260	
   261	        for (String outputName : decoder.outputs()) {
   262	            if (outputName.contains("present") && outputName.contains("key")) {
   263	                presentKeyNames.add(outputName);
   264	            } else if (outputName.contains("present") && outputName.contains("value")) {
   265	                presentValueNames.add(outputName);
   266	            }
   267	        }
   268	
   269	        Collections.sort(presentKeyNames);
   270	        Collections.sort(presentValueNames);
   271	
   272	        return new KVCacheNames(presentKeyNames, presentValueNames);
   273	    }
   274	
   275	    // ==================== Static KV Cache for CUDA Graph Replay ====================
   276	
   277	    /**
   278	     * Pad KV cache tensors from prefill to a fixed static size for CUDA graph replay.
   279	     *
   280	     * Takes the present_kv outputs from prefill (shape [batch, heads, prefillLen, dim])
   281	     * and creates new tensors padded to [batch, heads, maxKvLen, dim] with zeros for
   282	     * unfilled positions. Returns a map from past_key_values input names to the padded tensors.
   283	     *
   284	     * @param prefillOutputs map of present output names to their tensors from prefill
   285	     * @param presentKeyNames list of present key output names
   286	     * @param presentValueNames list of present value output names
   287	     * @param maxKvLen maximum KV cache length (prefillLen + maxNewTokens)
   288	     * @return map from past_key_values input names to static padded tensors
   289	     */
   290	    public static Map<String, INDArray> padKvCacheToStaticSize(
   291	            Map<String, INDArray> prefillOutputs,
   292	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   293	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   294	            long maxKvLen) {
   295	        return padKvCacheToStaticSize(prefillOutputs, presentKeyNames, presentValueNames,
   296	                maxKvLen, ModelIOConfig.builder().build());
   297	    }
   298	
   299	    /**
   300	     * Pad KV cache tensors from prefill to a fixed static size, using ModelIOConfig for name mapping.
   301	     *
   302	     * @param ioConfig the model I/O configuration for present-to-past name mapping
   303	     */
   304	    public static Map<String, INDArray> padKvCacheToStaticSize(
   305	            Map<String, INDArray> prefillOutputs,
   306	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   307	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   308	            long maxKvLen,
   309	            ModelIOConfig ioConfig) {
   310	
   311	        Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers = new HashMap<>();
   312	        List<String> allPresentNames = new ArrayList<>();
   313	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentKeyNames);
   314	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentValueNames);
   315	
   316	        for (String presentName : allPresentNames) {
   317	            INDArray prefillKv = prefillOutputs.get(presentName);
   318	            if (prefillKv == null) continue;
   319	
   320	            // prefillKv shape: [batch, heads, prefillLen, dim]
   321	            long[] shape = prefillKv.shape();
   322	            long batch = shape[0];
   323	            long heads = shape[1];
   324	            long prefillLen = shape[2];
   325	            long dim = shape[3];
   326	
   327	            // Create static buffer: [batch, heads, maxKvLen, dim]
   328	            INDArray staticBuf = Nd4j.zeros(prefillKv.dataType(), batch, heads, maxKvLen, dim);
   329	
   330	            // Copy prefill data into positions 0..prefillLen-1
   331	            if (prefillLen > 0) {
   332	                INDArray destSlice = staticBuf.get(
   333	                        NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   334	                        NDArrayIndex.interval(0, prefillLen), NDArrayIndex.all());
   335	                destSlice.assign(prefillKv);
   336	            }
   337	
   338	            // Map present name -> past_key_values input name using ModelIOConfig
   339	            String pastInputName = ioConfig.presentToInputName(presentName);
   340	            // Protect static KV buffers from accidental closure / GC deallocation.
   341	            // These buffers must survive for the entire decode loop. Without this,
   342	            // trimMemoryPoolOnStream or DeallocatorService can free them on multi-GPU setups
   343	            // where buffers are on a non-peer device.
   344	            staticBuf.setCloseable(false);
   345	            staticKvBuffers.put(pastInputName, staticBuf);
   346	
   347	            log.info("  Static KV buffer '{}': [{},{},{},{}] (prefill={} padded to {})",
   348	                    pastInputName, batch, heads, maxKvLen, dim, prefillLen, maxKvLen);
   349	        }
   350	
   351	        return staticKvBuffers;
   352	    }
   353	
   354	    /**
   355	     * Scatter the new KV entry from decoder output into the static KV buffer at cachePos.
   356	     *
   357	     * The decoder concatenates past_kv [batch,heads,maxKvLen,dim] with the new token's KV,
   358	     * producing present_kv [batch,heads,maxKvLen+1,dim]. The new token's entry is at the
   359	     * last position (index maxKvLen). We extract it and write it into the static buffer
   360	     * at position cachePos.
   361	     *
   362	     * @param staticKvBuffers map of past_key_values input names to static buffers
   363	     * @param decoderOutputs map of decoder output names to tensors
   364	     * @param presentKeyNames list of present key output names
   365	     * @param presentValueNames list of present value output names
   366	     * @param maxKvLen the static KV length (without the +1 from concat)
   367	     * @param cachePos the position in the static buffer to write the new entry
   368	     */
   369	    public static void scatterNewKvEntries(
   370	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers,
   371	            Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs,
   372	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   373	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   374	            long maxKvLen,
   375	            long cachePos) {
   376	        scatterNewKvEntries(staticKvBuffers, decoderOutputs, presentKeyNames, presentValueNames,
   377	                maxKvLen, cachePos, ModelIOConfig.builder().build());
   378	    }
   379	
   380	    /**
   381	     * Scatter the new KV entry from decoder output into the static KV buffer at cachePos,
   382	     * using ModelIOConfig for present-to-past name mapping.
   383	     */
   384	    public static void scatterNewKvEntries(
   385	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers,
   386	            Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs,
   387	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   388	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   389	            long maxKvLen,
   390	            long cachePos,
   391	            ModelIOConfig ioConfig) {
   392	
   393	        // Collect all valid pairs for batched native scatter
   394	        List<INDArray> staticList = new ArrayList<>();
   395	        List<INDArray> presentList = new ArrayList<>();
   396	
   397	        List<String> allPresentNames = new ArrayList<>();
   398	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentKeyNames);
   399	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentValueNames);
   400	
   401	        int skippedClosed = 0;
   402	        for (String presentName : allPresentNames) {
   403	            INDArray presentKv = decoderOutputs.get(presentName);
   404	            if (presentKv == null) continue;
   405	
   406	            String pastInputName = ioConfig.presentToInputName(presentName);
   407	            INDArray staticBuf = staticKvBuffers.get(pastInputName);
   408	            if (staticBuf != null) {
   409	                // Guard: skip closed arrays to prevent native op crash.
   410	                // This can happen when DeallocatorService/GC frees cross-device buffers.
   411	                if (staticBuf.wasClosed() || staticBuf.data() == null) {
   412	                    skippedClosed++;
   413	                    continue;
   414	                }
   415	                if (presentKv.wasClosed() || presentKv.data() == null) {
   416	                    skippedClosed++;
   417	                    continue;
   418	                }
   419	                staticList.add(staticBuf);
   420	                presentList.add(presentKv);
   421	            }
   422	        }
   423	
   424	        if (skippedClosed > 0) {
   425	            log.warn("scatterNewKvEntries: skipped {} closed arrays at cachePos={}", skippedClosed, cachePos);
   426	        }
   427	        if (staticList.isEmpty()) return;
   428	
   429	        // Single native op call for all pairs — one JNI round-trip + one kernel launch
   430	        Nd4j.exec(new org.nd4j.linalg.api.ops.impl.transforms.custom.KvScatter(
   431	                staticList.toArray(new INDArray[0]),
   432	                presentList.toArray(new INDArray[0]),
   433	                cachePos));
   434	    }
   435	
   436	    /**
   437	     * Scatter a specific source position from present KV outputs into the static KV buffer.
   438	     *
   439	     * Used for multi-token KV scatter in speculative decoding, where multiple positions
   440	     * from a single forward pass need to be scattered into the static KV cache.
   441	     *
   442	     * @param staticKvBuffers map of past_key_values input names to static buffers
   443	     * @param decoderOutputs map of decoder output names to tensors
   444	     * @param presentKeyNames list of present key output names
   445	     * @param presentValueNames list of present value output names
   446	     * @param maxKvLen the static KV length
   447	     * @param targetCachePos the position in the static buffer to write the entry
   448	     * @param sourcePosition which position in present KV [0..seqLen-1] to extract
   449	     */
   450	    public static void scatterNewKvEntryAtPosition(
   451	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers,
   452	            Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs,
   453	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   454	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   455	            long maxKvLen,
   456	            long targetCachePos,
   457	            int sourcePosition) {
   458	        scatterNewKvEntryAtPosition(staticKvBuffers, decoderOutputs, presentKeyNames,
   459	                presentValueNames, maxKvLen, targetCachePos, sourcePosition,
   460	                ModelIOConfig.builder().build());
   461	    }
   462	
   463	    /**
   464	     * Scatter a specific source position from present KV outputs into the static KV buffer,
   465	     * using ModelIOConfig for present-to-past name mapping.
   466	     */
   467	    public static void scatterNewKvEntryAtPosition(
   468	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers,
   469	            Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs,
   470	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   471	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   472	            long maxKvLen,
   473	            long targetCachePos,
   474	            int sourcePosition,
   475	            ModelIOConfig ioConfig) {
   476	
   477	        List<String> allPresentNames = new ArrayList<>();
   478	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentKeyNames);
   479	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentValueNames);
   480	
   481	        for (String presentName : allPresentNames) {
   482	            INDArray presentKv = decoderOutputs.get(presentName);
   483	            if (presentKv == null) continue;
   484	
   485	            String pastInputName = ioConfig.presentToInputName(presentName);
   486	            INDArray staticBuf = staticKvBuffers.get(pastInputName);
   487	            if (staticBuf == null) continue;
   488	
   489	            // Extract [batch, heads, 1, dim] at sourcePosition from present KV
   490	            INDArray sourceSlice = presentKv.get(
   491	                    NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   492	                    NDArrayIndex.point(sourcePosition), NDArrayIndex.all());
   493	
   494	            // Write into static buffer at targetCachePos
   495	            INDArray destSlice = staticBuf.get(
   496	                    NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   497	                    NDArrayIndex.point(targetCachePos), NDArrayIndex.all());
   498	            destSlice.assign(sourceSlice);
   499	        }
   500	    }
   501	
   502	    /**
   503	     * Scatter multiple accepted positions from a speculative decode step into the static KV cache.
   504	     *
   505	     * Combines multiple source positions from present KV outputs into consecutive
   506	     * target positions in the static KV buffer. More efficient than calling
   507	     * scatterNewKvEntryAtPosition in a loop when scattering contiguous ranges.
   508	     *
   509	     * @param staticKvBuffers map of past_key_values input names to static buffers
   510	     * @param decoderOutputs map of decoder output names to tensors
   511	     * @param presentKeyNames list of present key output names
   512	     * @param presentValueNames list of present value output names
   513	     * @param maxKvLen the static KV length
   514	     * @param baseCachePos starting position in the static buffer
   515	     * @param numPositions number of positions to scatter (0..numPositions-1 from present)
   516	     */
   517	    public static void scatterMultipleKvEntries(
   518	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers,
   519	            Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs,
   520	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   521	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   522	            long maxKvLen,
   523	            long baseCachePos,
   524	            int numPositions) {
   525	        scatterMultipleKvEntries(staticKvBuffers, decoderOutputs, presentKeyNames,
   526	                presentValueNames, maxKvLen, baseCachePos, numPositions,
   527	                ModelIOConfig.builder().build());
   528	    }
   529	
   530	    /**
   531	     * Scatter multiple accepted positions from a speculative decode step into the static KV cache,
   532	     * using ModelIOConfig for present-to-past name mapping.
   533	     */
   534	    public static void scatterMultipleKvEntries(
   535	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers,
   536	            Map<String, INDArray> decoderOutputs,
   537	            List<String> presentKeyNames,
   538	            List<String> presentValueNames,
   539	            long maxKvLen,
   540	            long baseCachePos,
   541	            int numPositions,
   542	            ModelIOConfig ioConfig) {
   543	
   544	        if (numPositions <= 0) return;
   545	
   546	        List<String> allPresentNames = new ArrayList<>();
   547	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentKeyNames);
   548	        allPresentNames.addAll(presentValueNames);
   549	
   550	        for (String presentName : allPresentNames) {
   551	            INDArray presentKv = decoderOutputs.get(presentName);
   552	            if (presentKv == null) continue;
   553	
   554	            String pastInputName = ioConfig.presentToInputName(presentName);
   555	            INDArray staticBuf = staticKvBuffers.get(pastInputName);
   556	            if (staticBuf == null) continue;
   557	
   558	            // Present KV shape: [1, heads, maxKvLen+seqLen, dim] = concat(past, new)
   559	            // New entries start at position maxKvLen in the present output
   560	            INDArray sourceSlice = presentKv.get(
   561	                    NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   562	                    NDArrayIndex.interval(maxKvLen, maxKvLen + numPositions),
   563	                    NDArrayIndex.all());
   564	
   565	            INDArray destSlice = staticBuf.get(
   566	                    NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   567	                    NDArrayIndex.interval(baseCachePos, baseCachePos + numPositions),
   568	                    NDArrayIndex.all());
   569	            destSlice.assign(sourceSlice);
   570	        }
   571	    }
   572	
   573	    /**
   574	     * Build the complete decoder input map for one decode step.
   575	     *
   576	     * Handles both dynamic KV (prefill, step 0) and static KV (decode, steps 1+) modes.
   577	     * Constructs inputs_embeds, attention_mask, _causal_mask, input_ids, position_ids,
   578	     * and past_key_values entries based on the decoder's declared input names.
   579	     *
   580	     * @param decoderInputNames the decoder model's input names
   581	     * @param decoder the SameDiff decoder model (for createEmptyKvCache fallback)
   582	     * @param embeddings current step's embeddings [batch, seqLen, hidden]
   583	     * @param inputIds current step's input IDs [batch, seqLen]
   584	     * @param pastSeqLen logical past sequence length (for position_ids / RoPE)
   585	     * @param currentSeqLen current step's sequence length
   586	     * @param staticKvBuffers map of past_key_values input names to static buffers (null if not using static KV)
   587	     * @param maxKvLen total static KV length (ignored if not using static KV)
   588	     * @param cachePos next write position in static buffer (ignored if not using static KV)
   589	     * @param usingStaticKv whether we are in static KV mode
   590	     * @param hiddenSize model hidden size (for empty KV cache creation)
   591	     * @return map of input name to INDArray ready to pass to decoder.output()
   592	     */
   593	    public static Map<String, INDArray> buildDecoderInputMap(
   594	            List<String> decoderInputNames, SameDiff decoder,
   595	            INDArray embeddings, INDArray inputIds,
   596	            long pastSeqLen, long currentSeqLen,
   597	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers, long maxKvLen, long cachePos,
   598	            boolean usingStaticKv, long hiddenSize) {
   599	        return buildDecoderInputMap(decoderInputNames, decoder, embeddings, inputIds,
   600	                pastSeqLen, currentSeqLen, staticKvBuffers, maxKvLen, cachePos,
   601	                usingStaticKv, hiddenSize, null, false);
   602	    }
   603	
   604	    /**
   605	     * Build the complete decoder input map for one decode step, with optional reusable input cache.
   606	     *
   607	     * When {@code reusableInputs} is non-null and in static KV mode with seqLen=1,
   608	     * attention_mask, _causal_mask, and position_ids are allocated once and updated in-place
   609	     * on subsequent calls, avoiding per-step allocations.
   610	     *
   611	     * @param reusableInputs optional cache map; populated on first use, updated in-place thereafter
   612	     * @param dspActive whether DSP (DynamicShapePlan) is active — determines padded vs view-based inputs.
   613	     *                  When true: full static KV buffer + sparse attention_mask (fixed shapes for CUDA graphs).
   614	     *                  When false: KV views [0:cachePos] + all-ones attention_mask (growing shapes).
   615	     */
   616	    public static Map<String, INDArray> buildDecoderInputMap(
   617	            List<String> decoderInputNames, SameDiff decoder,
   618	            INDArray embeddings, INDArray inputIds,
   619	            long pastSeqLen, long currentSeqLen,
   620	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers, long maxKvLen, long cachePos,
   621	            boolean usingStaticKv, long hiddenSize,
   622	            Map<String, INDArray> reusableInputs,
   623	            boolean dspActive) {
   624	        ModelIOConfig config = ModelIOConfig.builder().build();
   625	        return buildDecoderInputMap(config, decoderInputNames, decoder, embeddings, inputIds,
   626	                pastSeqLen, currentSeqLen, staticKvBuffers, maxKvLen, cachePos,
   627	                usingStaticKv, hiddenSize, reusableInputs, dspActive,
   628	                null, null);
   629	    }
   630	
   631	    /**
   632	     * Build the complete decoder input map using a {@link ModelIOConfig} for variable name resolution.
   633	     *
   634	     * <p>This is the primary implementation that all other buildDecoderInputMap overloads delegate to.
   635	     * Uses the config's name fields instead of hardcoded string comparisons, enabling the same
   636	     * code to work with models that use different variable naming conventions.</p>
   637	     *
   638	     * @param ioConfig the model I/O configuration with variable name mappings
   639	     * @param decoderInputNames the decoder model's input names
   640	     * @param decoder the SameDiff decoder model (for createEmptyKvCache fallback)
   641	     * @param embeddings current step's embeddings [batch, seqLen, hidden]
   642	     * @param inputIds current step's input IDs [batch, seqLen]
   643	     * @param pastSeqLen logical past sequence length (for position_ids / RoPE)
   644	     * @param currentSeqLen current step's sequence length
   645	     * @param staticKvBuffers map of past_key_values input names to static buffers (null if not using static KV)
   646	     * @param maxKvLen total static KV length (ignored if not using static KV)
   647	     * @param cachePos next write position in static buffer (ignored if not using static KV)
   648	     * @param usingStaticKv whether we are in static KV mode
   649	     * @param hiddenSize model hidden size (for empty KV cache creation)
   650	     * @param reusableInputs optional cache map; populated on first use, updated in-place thereafter
   651	     * @param dspActive whether DSP is active (padded mode with fixed shapes for CUDA graphs)
   652	     * @return map of input name to INDArray ready to pass to decoder.output()
   653	     */
   654	    public static Map<String, INDArray> buildDecoderInputMap(
   655	            ModelIOConfig ioConfig,
   656	            List<String> decoderInputNames, SameDiff decoder,
   657	            INDArray embeddings, INDArray inputIds,
   658	            long pastSeqLen, long currentSeqLen,
   659	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers, long maxKvLen, long cachePos,
   660	            boolean usingStaticKv, long hiddenSize,
   661	            Map<String, INDArray> reusableInputs,
   662	            boolean dspActive) {
   663	        return buildDecoderInputMap(ioConfig, decoderInputNames, decoder, embeddings, inputIds,
   664	                pastSeqLen, currentSeqLen, staticKvBuffers, maxKvLen, cachePos,
   665	                usingStaticKv, hiddenSize, reusableInputs, dspActive,
   666	                null, null);
   667	    }
   668	
   669	    /**
   670	     * Build the complete decoder input map with encoder-decoder support.
   671	     *
   672	     * <p>For encoder-decoder models (e.g., Whisper), encoder hidden states and encoder
   673	     * attention mask are passed as additional inputs at every decode step. These are
   674	     * constant across decode steps (computed once by the encoder).</p>
   675	     *
   676	     * @param encoderOutputs encoder hidden states [batch, encoderSeqLen, hiddenSize], null for decoder-only
   677	     * @param encoderAttentionMask encoder attention mask [batch, encoderSeqLen], null if not needed
   678	     */
   679	    public static Map<String, INDArray> buildDecoderInputMap(
   680	            ModelIOConfig ioConfig,
   681	            List<String> decoderInputNames, SameDiff decoder,
   682	            INDArray embeddings, INDArray inputIds,
   683	            long pastSeqLen, long currentSeqLen,
   684	            Map<String, INDArray> staticKvBuffers, long maxKvLen, long cachePos,
   685	            boolean usingStaticKv, long hiddenSize,
   686	            Map<String, INDArray> reusableInputs,
   687	            boolean dspActive,
   688	            INDArray encoderOutputs, INDArray encoderAttentionMask) {
   689	
   690	        Map<String, INDArray> decoderInputMap = new HashMap<>();
   691	        boolean canReuse = reusableInputs != null && usingStaticKv && currentSeqLen == 1;
   692	        // DSP active = padded inputs with full static KV buffer (fixed shapes)
   693	        boolean usePadded = dspActive && usingStaticKv;
   694	        List<String> materializedInputNames = expandConfiguredInputNames(ioConfig, decoderInputNames, decoder);
   695	
   696	        for (String inputName : materializedInputNames) {
   697	            if (ioConfig.isInputEmbeddings(inputName)) {
   698	                decoderInputMap.put(inputName, embeddings);
   699	            } else if (ioConfig.isAttentionMask(inputName)) {
   700	                if (usePadded) {
   701	                    // Padded mode with in-place KV write: shapes must match the model's
   702	                    // attn_mask_reformat subgraph which derives KV length from
   703	                    // past_key_shape[2] + current_key_shape[1] = maxKvLen + currentSeqLen.
   704	                    // The in-place write ensures current K is at cachePos (visible to causal mask),
   705	                    // while the concat'd copy at maxKvLen is masked (maxKvLen > cachePos).
   706	                    long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + currentSeqLen;
   707	                    if (canReuse && reusableInputs.containsKey(inputName)) {
   708	                        INDArray mask = reusableInputs.get(inputName);
   709	                        // Ensure ALL positions [0, cachePos) are set to 1.
   710	                        // After prefill→decode transition, cachePos jumps from 0 to
   711	                        // prefillSeqLen. The incremental per-step update (cachePos-1)
   712	                        // only sets one position — we need the full range.
   713	                        if (cachePos > 0) {
   714	                            mask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePos)).assign(1);
   715	                        }
   716	                        // Current token position at the end
   717	                        mask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1);
   718	                        decoderInputMap.put(inputName, mask);
   719	                    } else {
   720	                        INDArray mask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, totalSeqLen);
   721	                        if (cachePos > 0) {
   722	                            mask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.interval(0, cachePos)).assign(1);
   723	                        }
   724	                        mask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1);
   725	                        decoderInputMap.put(inputName, mask);
   726	                        if (canReuse) reusableInputs.put(inputName, mask);
   727	                    }
   728	                } else if (usingStaticKv) {
   729	                    // View-based mode: contiguous all-ones mask matching KV view size
