  1165	  // When shapes are frozen (after warmup), pre-populate from outputSlots_ so
  1166	  // downstream ops can read inputs without each slot individually setting outputSlots_.
  1167	  // View-producer slots will be overwritten during execution.
  1168	  //
  1169	  // Non-capturable (and permanently capture-failed) segments execute slot-by-slot
  1170	  // across decode steps. Their shape-driving scalar tensors often keep the same
  1171	  // shape while values change (KV length growth), so cross-execution shape cache
  1172	  // reuse can become stale and cause later broadcast mismatches. Invalidate these
  1173	  // segment-local caches each execute; capturable graph-replay segments keep caches.
  1174	
  1175	  // replayManagedSlots REMOVED: arrays persist (one array per slot), no protection needed.
  1176	
  1177	  // Build protected weight buffer set (once on first execute).
  1178	  // DataBuffers from external constants/variables must NEVER be freed. View ops
  1179	  // can produce intermediate NDArrays that share a DataBuffer with a model weight.
  1180	  // Without this protection, freeing the intermediate frees the weight's GPU memory
  1181	  // → CUDA illegal access (error 700) on re-execution.
  1182	  // This mirrors the Java-side protectedWeightBuffers in DynamicShapePlanExecutor.
  1183	  if (protectedWeightBuffers_.empty()) {
  1184	    for (int i = 0; i < numExternalInputs; i++) {
  1185	      if (externalInputs[i] != nullptr) {
  1186	        auto* db = externalInputs[i]->dataBuffer();
  1187	        bool isVariableInput = i < static_cast<int>(externalInputIsVariable_.size()) &&
  1188	                               externalInputIsVariable_[i];
  1189	        if (db != nullptr && !isVariableInput) {
  1190	          protectedWeightBuffers_.insert(db);
  1191	        }
  1192	      }
  1193	    }
  1194	    DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "built protectedWeightBuffers with %zu entries from %d external inputs "
  1195	             "(excluding variable/placeholder feeds)",
  1196	             protectedWeightBuffers_.size(), numExternalInputs);
  1197	
  1198	
  1199	  }
  1200	
  1201	  if (numExternalInputs > 0 && !protectedWeightBuffers_.empty()) {
  1202	    lifecycleExternalInputs.assign(externalInputs, externalInputs + numExternalInputs);
  1203	    bool filteredAny = false;
  1204	    for (int i = 0; i < numExternalInputs; i++) {
  1205	      NDArray* arr = externalInputs[i];
  1206	      DataBuffer* db = arr != nullptr ? arr->dataBuffer() : nullptr;
  1207	      bool trackForLifecycle = db != nullptr && protectedWeightBuffers_.count(db) > 0;
  1208	      if (!trackForLifecycle) {
  1209	        lifecycleExternalInputs[i] = nullptr;
  1210	        filteredAny = true;
  1211	      }
  1212	    }
  1213	    lifecycleExternalInputPtrs = filteredAny ? lifecycleExternalInputs.data() : externalInputs;
  1214	  }
  1215	
  1216	  // ── One array per slot: NO cleanup between executions ────────────────────
  1217	  // Same plan = same shapes. Arrays allocated on first execution, reused forever.
  1218	  // View ops create lightweight wrappers that are deleted inline when replaced.
  1219	  // No free→null→restore cycle. No pendingClose_. No release schedule.
  1220	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "execute: arrays persist (exec=%d, frozen=%d, slots=%d)",
  1221	           executeCount_, shapesFrozen_ ? 1 : 0, totalOutputSlots_);
  1222	
  1223	  // Non-frozen first execution only: reset segment state for warmup
  1224	  if (executeCount_ == 0 && !shapesFrozen_) {
  1225	    for (auto& segment : segments_) {
  1226	      segment.exec.executionCount = 0;
  1227	      segment.exec.compilationFailed = false;
  1228	      segment.exec.captureOomRetries = 0;
  1229	      segment.exec.captureRetryAfterExec = 0;
  1230	      segment.exec.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  1231	      segment.exec.capturedInputAddrKey = 0;
  1232	      segment.exec.capturedCreateValueKey = 0;
  1233	      segment.exec.gapOpsCapturedInGraph = false;
  1234	      if (segment.exec.replayHandle) {
  1235	        platformCleanupSegmentForRebuild(segment);
  1236	      }
  1237	    }
  1238	  }
  1239	
  1240	  if (!shapesFrozen_) {
  1241	    platformClearCastCache();
  1242	  }
  1243	
  1244	  // Reset dead-slot flags once per plan execution (not per segment).
  1245	  // Dead flags from Switch in one segment must persist to affect ops in later segments.
  1246	  if (hasControlFlow_ && slotIsDead_ != nullptr) {
  1247	    std::memset(slotIsDead_, 0, sizeof(bool) * slotIsDeadSize_);
  1248	  }
  1249	
  1250	  // Timing instrumentation
  1251	  using Clock = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock;
  1252	  auto t0 = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
  1253	  PhaseExecutionStats phaseStats;
  1254	  bool phaseHandledPostSegments = false;
  1255	  bool phaseHandledOutputs = false;
  1256	
  1257	  // Step 1b: Parallel precompilation of all GPU-compilable segments.
  1258	  // Skip the first frozen warmup because shapes are still being populated.
  1259	  // phaseCompile() itself checks compilationDone_ and returns immediately if already done.
  1260	  if (!compilationDone_ && !(shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ == 0) &&
  1261	      graphExecutionMode_ != GraphExecutionMode::GEM_SLOT_BY_SLOT) {
  1262	    phaseCompile(externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1263	  }
  1264	
  1265	  Status phaseStatus = Status::OK;
  1266	  if (shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ == 0) {
  1267	    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PHASE_DISPATCH: phaseWarmup (frozen=%d execCount=%d mode=%d)",
  1268	             static_cast<int>(shapesFrozen_), executeCount_, static_cast<int>(graphExecutionMode_));
  1269	    phaseStatus = phaseWarmup(externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream, &phaseStats);
  1270	  } else if (graphExecutionMode_ == GraphExecutionMode::GEM_SLOT_BY_SLOT) {
  1271	    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PHASE_DISPATCH: phaseSlotBySlot (frozen=%d execCount=%d mode=%d)",
  1272	             static_cast<int>(shapesFrozen_), executeCount_, static_cast<int>(graphExecutionMode_));
  1273	    phaseStatus = phaseSlotBySlot(externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream, &phaseStats);
  1274	  } else {
  1275	    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PHASE_DISPATCH: phaseReplay (frozen=%d execCount=%d mode=%d)",
  1276	             static_cast<int>(shapesFrozen_), executeCount_, static_cast<int>(graphExecutionMode_));
  1277	    phaseStatus = phaseReplay(externalInputs, numExternalInputs, requestedOutputs,
  1278	                              numRequestedOutputs, stream, &phaseStats);
  1279	    phaseHandledPostSegments = true;
  1280	    phaseHandledOutputs = true;
  1281	  }
  1282	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PHASE_DISPATCH: phase returned status=%d", static_cast<int>(phaseStatus));
  1283	  if (phaseStatus != Status::OK) return phaseStatus;
  1284	
  1285	  auto tSegsDone = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
  1286	
  1287	  if (!phaseHandledPostSegments) {
  1288	    platformPostSegmentPoolManagement(shapesFrozen_, executeCount_);
  1289	  }
  1290	
  1291	  // ── Consistency assertions: verify slot reuse and replay integrity ───
  1292	  // These checks run after every execution to catch lifecycle bugs early.
  1293	  if (DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(VERIFY)) {
  1294	    int nullSlots = 0, liveSlots = 0, viewSlots = 0;
  1295	    int replaySegs = 0, slotBySlotSegsCount = 0, compilationFailedSegs = 0;
  1296	    for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  1297	      if (outputSlots_[i] == nullptr) { nullSlots++; }
  1298	      else {
  1299	        liveSlots++;
  1300	        auto* db = outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer();
  1301	        if (db != nullptr && protectedWeightBuffers_.count(db) > 0) viewSlots++;
  1302	      }
  1303	    }
  1304	    for (const auto& seg : segments_) {
  1305	      if (seg.exec.replayHandle && seg.exec.replayHandle->isReady()) replaySegs++;
  1306	      else if (seg.exec.compilationFailed) compilationFailedSegs++;
  1307	      else slotBySlotSegsCount++;
  1308	    }
  1309	    DSP_DIAG(VERIFY, "POST_EXEC exec=%d frozen=%d: slots(live=%d null=%d weightView=%d/%d) "
  1310	             "segs(replay=%d sbs=%d capFail=%d/%d) graphReplays=%d slotBySlot=%d",
  1311	             executeCount_, shapesFrozen_ ? 1 : 0,
  1312	             liveSlots, nullSlots, viewSlots, totalOutputSlots_,
  1313	             replaySegs, slotBySlotSegsCount, compilationFailedSegs, (int)segments_.size(),
  1314	             phaseStats.graphReplaySegs, phaseStats.slotBySlotSegs);
  1315	  }
  1316	
  1317	  if (!phaseHandledOutputs) {
  1318	    for (int i = 0; i < numRequestedOutputs_; i++) {
  1319	      int slotIdx = requestedOutputSlotIndices_[i];
  1320	      if (slotIdx >= 0 && slotIdx < totalOutputSlots_) {
  1321	        requestedOutputs[i] = outputSlots_[slotIdx];
  1322	      } else {
  1323	        requestedOutputs[i] = nullptr;
  1324	      }
  1325	    }
  1326	  }
  1327	
  1328	  // Diagnostic: dump requested output slot info and argmax for logits comparison
  1329	  if (DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(VERIFY) && sd::graph::DspDiagnostics::getInstance().withinExecLimit(executeCount_)) {
  1330	    for (int i = 0; i < numRequestedOutputs_; i++) {
  1331	      int slotIdx = requestedOutputSlotIndices_[i];
  1332	      if (requestedOutputs[i] != nullptr) {
  1333	        auto* arr = requestedOutputs[i];
  1334	        DSP_DIAG_SLOT(VERIFY, slotIdx,
  1335	            "reqOut[%d] len=%lld dt=%d rank=%d",
  1336	            i, (long long)arr->lengthOf(), (int)arr->dataType(), arr->rankOf());
  1337	        platformDumpLogitsArgmax(executeCount_, stream);
  1338	      } else {
  1339	        DSP_DIAG_SLOT(VERIFY, slotIdx, "reqOut[%d] nullptr", i);
  1340	      }
  1341	    }
  1342	  }
  1343	
  1344	  if (!phaseHandledOutputs && kvCacheRetentionEnabled_) {
  1345	    scatterKvEntries(externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
  1346	    kvCachePosition_++;
  1347	  }
  1348	
  1349	  auto tOutputsDone = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
  1350	
  1351	  // Step 4: No flush needed — arrays persist (one array per slot)
  1352	  auto tFlushDone = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
  1353	
  1354	  // Log plan-owned array count and total GPU allocation
  1355	  DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "DSP_EXEC_END execCount=%d: planOwnedArrays=%d totalSlots=%d",
  1356	            executeCount_, (int)planOwnedArrays_.size(), totalOutputSlots_);
  1357	
  1358	  // Track execution count for shapes-frozen optimization
  1359	  if (shapesFrozen_) executeCount_++;
  1360	
  1361	  // Re-classify slot ownership after the first frozen execution (capture step).
  1362	  // The capture execution replaces slot arrays (new allocations for different shapes),
  1363	  // which invalidates the compile-time ownership classification. Without this,
  1364	  // the next execution's lifecycle validation fails with "stale ownership".
  1365	  if (shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ == 2 && slotOwnership_ != nullptr && outputSlots_ != nullptr) {
  1366	    for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  1367	      if (outputSlots_[i] == nullptr) {
  1368	        slotOwnership_[i].reset();
  1369	        continue;
  1370	      }
  1371	      auto* db = outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer();
  1372	      if (db == nullptr) {
  1373	        slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::UNSET;
  1374	        slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = nullptr;
  1375	        continue;
  1376	      }
  1377	      if (protectedWeightBuffers_.count(db) > 0) {
  1378	        slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_WEIGHT;
  1379	        slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  1380	        continue;
  1381	      }
  1382	      bool isView = false;
  1383	      for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
  1384	        if (outputSlots_[j] != nullptr && outputSlots_[j]->dataBuffer() == db) {
  1385	          slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::VIEW_OF_SLOT;
  1386	          slotOwnership_[i].parentSlotIdx = j;
  1387	          slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  1388	          isView = true;
  1389	          break;
  1390	        }
  1391	      }
  1392	      if (!isView) {
  1393	        slotOwnership_[i].ownership = BufferOwnership::SLOT_OWNED;
  1394	        slotOwnership_[i].dataBuffer = db;
  1395	      }
  1396	    }
  1397	  }
  1398	
  1399	  // ── Plan-level phase advancement ───────────────────────────────────────────
  1400	  // Phase transitions are automatic based on observed stability.
  1401	  // Snapshot capture and frozenExecutionCount_ increment happen here (need
  1402	  // external inputs), then advancePlanPhase() handles the transitions.
  1403	  if (shapesFrozen_ && planPhase_ >= PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN) {
  1404	    frozenExecutionCount_++;
  1405	
  1406	    // Capture a buffer pointer snapshot after the first frozen execution.
  1407	    if (frozenExecutionCount_ == 1 && !frozenSnapshot_.valid) {
  1408	      frozenSnapshot_.capture(outputSlots_, totalOutputSlots_,
  1409	                               lifecycleExternalInputPtrs, numExternalInputs);
  1410	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "LIFECYCLE: captured buffer pointer snapshot (%d slots, %d extInputs)",
  1411	               totalOutputSlots_, numExternalInputs);
  1412	      {
  1413	        int ts = sd::graph::DspDiagnostics::getInstance().traceSlot();
  1414	        if (ts >= 0 && ts < totalOutputSlots_ && outputSlots_[ts] != nullptr) {
  1415	          DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "SNAPSHOT_SLOT_%d: arr=%p db=%p special=%p len=%lld",
  1416	                   ts, (void*)outputSlots_[ts], (void*)outputSlots_[ts]->dataBuffer(),
  1417	                   (void*)outputSlots_[ts]->specialBuffer(),
  1418	                   (long long)outputSlots_[ts]->lengthOf());
  1419	        }
  1420	      }
  1421	    }
  1422	
  1423	    advancePlanPhase();
  1424	  }
  1425	
  1426	  // Frozen constant detection MUST run BEFORE Triton precompilation.
  1427	  // detectFrozenConstants() marks shape_of and other constant-producing slots as
  1428	  // FROZEN_CONSTANT. The Triton IR builder checks frozenConstantSlot() and skips
  1429	  // these slots — preventing the compiled kernel from overwriting frozen constant
  1430	  // device buffers during graph replay. If precompilation runs first, the Triton
  1431	  // kernel includes frozen constant ops, and replay corrupts their device data.
  1432	  detectFrozenConstants();
  1433	
  1434	  // Eager precompilation: after warmup (executeCount_ just became 1), all shapes
  1435	  // are populated in outputSlots_. Compile all Triton modules now so the 2nd
  1436	  // execute() goes straight to replay instead of blocking on compilation.
  1437	  // compilationDone_ gate ensures this only happens once per plan lifecycle.
  1438	  if (!compilationDone_ && shapesFrozen_ && executeCount_ == 1) {
  1439	    phaseCompile(externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1440	  }
  1441	
  1442	  platformDetectAndPrepareBatchedGemm(externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
  1443	
  1444	  // Adaptive segment splitting (GPU only): if a segment's shape key
  1445	  // changes for consecutive executions, split it at the midpoint.
  1446	  platformMaybeSplitIfEnabled();
  1447	
  1448	  // Print timing breakdown
  1449	  if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
  1450	    auto segMs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(tSegsDone - t0).count();
  1451	    auto outMs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(tOutputsDone - tSegsDone).count();
  1452	    auto flushMs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(tFlushDone - tOutputsDone).count();
  1453	    auto totalMs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(tFlushDone - t0).count();
  1454	    DSP_DIAG(TIMING, "segments=%lldus outputs=%lldus flush=%lldus total=%lldus (%d segs, %d slots) | graph=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots) sbs=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots)",
  1455	             segMs, outMs, flushMs, totalMs,
  1500	  cpuGraphBackendChecked_ = false;
  1501	  cpuGraphBackend_ = nullptr;
  1502	  cpuGraphBackendChainBuilt_ = false;
  1503	  cpuGraphBackendChain_.clear();
  1504	}
  1505	
  1506	// ─── Memory management ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1507	
  1508	// View wrappers deleted inline in slotexec. No batched/deferred close needed.
  1509	
  1510	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::setShapesFrozen(bool frozen) {
  1511	  if (frozen) {
  1512	    DSP_REQUIRE_PLAN_PHASE_AT_MOST(PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT, "setShapesFrozen(true)");
  1513	  }
  1514	  bool wasFrozen = shapesFrozen_;
  1515	  shapesFrozen_ = frozen;
  1516	  if (frozen && !wasFrozen) {
  1517	    auto status = phaseFreeze();
  1518	    if (status != Status::OK) {
  1519	      DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "setShapesFrozen(true): phaseFreeze failed with status %d",
  1520	               static_cast<int>(status));
  1521	    }
  1522	  }
  1523	  if (!frozen) {
  1524	    for (auto* db : protectedWeightBuffers_) {
  1525	      if (db != nullptr) db->removeFrozenRef();
  1526	    }
  1527	
  1528	    if (outputSlots_ != nullptr) {
  1529	      for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  1530	        if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr && outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer() != nullptr) {
  1531	          outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer()->removeFrozenRef();
  1532	        }
  1533	      }
  1534	      DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "setShapesFrozen(false): removed frozen ref from %d output slot DataBuffers", totalOutputSlots_);
  1535	    }
  1536	
  1537	    for (int i = 0; i < numSlots_; i++) {
  1538	      if (slots_[i].state_ >= NativeSlot::SlotState::FROZEN) {
  1539	        slots_[i].state_ = NativeSlot::SlotState::SHAPE_CACHED;
  1540	      }
  1541	    }
  1542	    frozenConstantDetectionDone_ = false;
  1543	
  1544	    planPhase_ = PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
  1545	    pointersStable_ = false;
  1546	    frozenExecutionCount_ = 0;
  1547	    executeCount_ = 0;
  1548	    compilationDone_ = false;
  1549	    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1550	      if (seg.exec.replayHandle) {
  1551	        platformCleanupSegmentForRebuild(seg);
  1552	      }
  1553	      seg.exec.executionCount = 0;
  1554	      seg.exec.argTableStable = false;
  1555	      seg.exec.gapOpsCapturedInGraph = false;
  1556	      seg.exec.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  1557	      seg.exec.capturedInputAddrKey = 0;
  1558	      seg.exec.capturedCreateValueKey = 0;
  1559	      seg.exec.compilationFailed = false;
  1560	      seg.exec.captureOomRetries = 0;
  1561	      seg.exec.captureRetryAfterExec = 0;
  1562	      seg.exec.lastReplayExecCount = 0;
  1563	      seg.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::WARMUP;
  1564	    }
  1565	    clearAllShapeCachesForce();
  1566	    frozenSnapshot_.clear();
  1567	  }
  1568	}
  1569	
  1570	// ─── Phase lifecycle methods ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  1571	// Each method encapsulates ALL work for its phase. No scattered logic.
  1572	
  1573	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::advancePlanPhase() {
  1574	  // ── Plan-level phase advancement ───────────────────────────────────────────
  1575	  // Phase transitions are automatic based on observed stability:
  1576	  //   SHAPES_FROZEN → POINTERS_STABLE: after 2+ frozen executions with every
  1577	  //                                     replay-eligible segment in pointer-stable state
  1578	  //   POINTERS_STABLE → REPLAYING:     when every replay-eligible segment reaches
  1579	  //                                     backend-specific replay steady state
  1580	  //
  1581	  // Caller is responsible for: incrementing frozenExecutionCount_, capturing
  1582	  // frozenSnapshot_ on first frozen execution.
  1583	  if (!shapesFrozen_ || planPhase_ < PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN) return;
  1584	
  1585	  // Check pointer stability across all replay-eligible segments.
  1586	  if (planPhase_ == PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN && frozenExecutionCount_ >= 2) {
  1587	    bool allStable = true;
  1588	    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1589	      if (!segmentHasStablePointersForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
  1590	        allStable = false;
  1591	        break;
  1592	      }
  1593	    }
  1594	    if (allStable) {
  1595	      pointersStable_ = true;
  1596	      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1597	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE;
  1598	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → POINTERS_STABLE (frozenExec=%d)",
  1599	               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1600	    }
  1601	  }
  1602	
  1603	  // Promote to REPLAYING only once every replay-eligible segment has reached
  1604	  // steady-state replay. Mixed-phase plans stay at POINTERS_STABLE.
  1605	  if (planPhase_ >= PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) {
  1606	    bool hasReplayEligibleSegment = false;
  1607	    bool allReplaying = true;
  1608	    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1609	      if (!segmentBlocksPlanPhase(seg)) continue;
  1610	      hasReplayEligibleSegment = true;
  1611	      if (!segmentIsFullyReplayingForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
  1612	        allReplaying = false;
  1613	        break;
  1614	      }
  1615	    }
  1616	    if (hasReplayEligibleSegment && allReplaying && planPhase_ != PlanPhase::REPLAYING) {
  1617	      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1618	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::REPLAYING;
  1619	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → REPLAYING (frozenExec=%d)",
  1620	               oldPhase, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1621	    }
  1622	  }
  1623	}
  1624	
  1625	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::demotePlanPhase(PlanPhase targetPhase, const char* reason) {
  1626	  const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1627	  const char* newPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(targetPhase);
  1628	  DSP_DIAG(FALLBACK, "PHASE_DEMOTION: %s → %s: %s (frozenExec=%d)",
  1629	           oldPhase, newPhase, reason, frozenExecutionCount_);
  1630	  planPhase_ = targetPhase;
  1631	  if (targetPhase < PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE) {
  1632	    pointersStable_ = false;
  1633	  }
  1634	}
  1635	
  1636	Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseFreeze() {
  1637	  DSP_REQUIRE_PLAN_PHASE_EXACT(PlanPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT, "phaseFreeze");
  1638	  auto& env = Environment::getInstance();
  1639	  bool mergeSegments = env.dspFreezeMergeSegments();
  1640	
  1641	  // ── Fusion pass (slot-by-slot → freeze transition) ──────────────────
  1642	  if (numSlots_ > 1) {
  1643	    auto fusions = FusionPass::detectFusions(slots_, numSlots_, externalInputRanks_);
  1644	    if (!fusions.empty()) {
  1645	      DSP_DIAG(FUSION, "detected %d fusion candidates (post-warmup)",
  1646	               (int)fusions.size());
  1647	      int applied = FusionPass::applyFusions(slots_, numSlots_, fusions);
  1648	      DSP_DIAG(FUSION, "applied %d of %d fusion candidates",
  1649	               applied, (int)fusions.size());
  1650	    }
  1651	  }
  1652	
  1653	  DSP_DIAG(SEGMENT, "SEGMENT_MAP: %d segments (frozen first exec)", (int)segments_.size());
  1654	  for (int i = 0; i < (int)segments_.size(); i++) {
  1655	    auto& s = segments_[i];
  1656	    DSP_DIAG(SEGMENT, "  seg[%d]: slots[%d-%d] capturable=%d hasReplay=%d "
  1657	             "compilationFailed=%d execCount=%d",
  1658	             i, s.def.startSlot, s.def.endSlot, s.def.isCapturable,
  1659	             s.exec.replayHandle != nullptr, s.exec.compilationFailed, s.exec.executionCount);
  1660	  }
  1661	
  1662	  planPhase_ = PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN;
  1663	  pointersStable_ = false;
  1664	  frozenExecutionCount_ = 0;
  1665	
  1666	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "FROZEN_TRANSITION: unfrozen → FROZEN, "
  1667	            "%d segments, %d slots, %d extInputs, mergeSegments=%d, recompile=%d",
  1668	            (int)segments_.size(), numSlots_, numExternalInputs_,
  1669	            mergeSegments ? 1 : 0, env.dspFreezeRecompile() ? 1 : 0);
  1670	
  1671	  MmulHelper::clearCastCache();
  1672	
  1673	  executeCount_ = 0;
  1674	  compilationDone_ = false;
  1675	  for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1676	    seg.exec.executionCount = 0;
  1677	    if (seg.exec.replayHandle) {
  1678	      platformCleanupSegmentForRebuild(seg);
  1679	    }
  1680	    seg.exec.argTableStable = false;
  1681	    seg.exec.gapOpsCapturedInGraph = false;
  1682	    seg.exec.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  1683	    seg.exec.capturedInputAddrKey = 0;
  1684	    seg.exec.capturedCreateValueKey = 0;
  1685	    seg.exec.compilationFailed = false;
  1686	    seg.exec.currentPhase = ExecutionPhase::WARMUP;
  1687	  }
  1688	
  1689	  for (auto* db : protectedWeightBuffers_) {
  1690	    if (db != nullptr) db->addFrozenRef();
  1691	  }
  1692	
  1693	  if (outputSlots_ != nullptr) {
  1694	    for (int i = 0; i < totalOutputSlots_; i++) {
  1695	      if (outputSlots_[i] != nullptr && outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer() != nullptr) {
  1696	        outputSlots_[i]->dataBuffer()->addFrozenRef();
  1697	      }
  1698	    }
  1699	    DSP_DIAG(MEMORY, "phaseFreeze: added frozen ref to %d output slot DataBuffers", totalOutputSlots_);
  1700	  }
  1701	
  1702	  return Status::OK;
  1703	}
  1704	
  1705	Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseWarmup(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs,
  1706	                                           void* stream, PhaseExecutionStats* stats) {
  1707	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseWarmup: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d", (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs);
  1708	
  1709	  long long slotBySlotUs = 0;
  1710	  int slotBySlotSegs = 0;
  1711	  int slotBySlotSlots = 0;
  1712	  using Clock = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock;
  1713	
  1714	  // Reset segment state for warmup
  1715	  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
  1716	    segment.exec.executionCount = 0;
  1717	    segment.exec.compilationFailed = false;
  1718	    segment.exec.captureOomRetries = 0;
  1719	    segment.exec.captureRetryAfterExec = 0;
  1720	    segment.exec.cachedShapeKey = 0;
  1721	    segment.exec.capturedInputAddrKey = 0;
  1722	    segment.exec.capturedCreateValueKey = 0;
  1723	    segment.exec.gapOpsCapturedInGraph = false;
  1724	    if (segment.exec.replayHandle) {
  1725	      platformCleanupSegmentForRebuild(segment);
  1726	    }
  1727	  }
  1728	
  1729	  platformClearCastCache();
  1730	
  1731	  // Execute all segments slot-by-slot to populate shapes
  1732	  int segIdx = 0;
  1733	  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
  1734	    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseWarmup: seg[%d] slots=[%d-%d] capturable=%d starting...",
  1735	             segIdx, segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot,
  1736	             static_cast<int>(segment.def.isCapturable));
  1737	    if (!platformBindSegmentDevice(segment)) {
  1738	      return Status::KERNEL_FAILURE;
  1739	    }
  1740	    platformMigrateSegmentInputs(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1741	
  1742	    segment.exec.currentPhase = segment.def.isCapturable
  1743	        ? ExecutionPhase::WARMUP
  1744	        : ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
  1745	
  1746	    auto tSegStart = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
  1747	    auto status = executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
  1748	    DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseWarmup: seg[%d] slots=[%d-%d] completed status=%d",
  1749	             segIdx, segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, static_cast<int>(status));
  1750	    segIdx++;
  1751	    if (status != Status::OK) return status;
  1752	
  1753	    // Increment executionCount so that executeSegmentWithGraph sees exec >= 1
  1754	    // and proceeds to graph capture instead of repeating warmup.
  1755	    segment.exec.executionCount = 1;
  1756	
  1757	    // Capture baseline shape and address keys for EMULATED_REPLAY segments.
  1758	    // Without these baselines, the first frozen replay computes keys and compares
  1759	    // against zeros — keys never match, argTableStable stays false, and the plan
  1760	    // is permanently stuck at SHAPES_FROZEN (frozenExecutionCount_ >= 2 but
  1761	    // segmentHasStablePointersForPlanPhase always returns false).
  1762	    // Note: computeSegmentShapeKey hashes small input values (<=32 elements) which
  1763	    // requires D2H sync, but this only happens once during warmup.
  1764	    if (segment.def.selectedBackend == SelectedBackend::EMULATED_REPLAY) {
  1765	      segment.exec.cachedShapeKey =
  1766	          computeSegmentShapeKey(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1767	      segment.exec.capturedInputAddrKey =
  1768	          computeSegmentInputAddrKeyPortable(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1769	    }
  1770	
  1771	    // Note: We intentionally do NOT call computeSegmentShapeKey for non-EMULATED_REPLAY
  1772	    // segments here. It is extremely expensive (per-element D2H sync for small inputs)
  1773	    // and unnecessary during warmup. executeSegmentWithGraph will compute the
  1774	    // key when it actually needs it for graph capture.
  1775	
  1776	    if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
  1777	      auto segUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(Clock::now() - tSegStart).count();
  1778	      slotBySlotUs += segUs;
  1779	      slotBySlotSegs++;
  1780	      slotBySlotSlots += segment.def.endSlot - segment.def.startSlot + 1;
  1781	    }
  1782	
  1783	    platformCleanupMigratedInputs();
  1784	    auto postStatus = platformCheckPostSegment(segment);
  1785	    if (postStatus != Status::OK) return postStatus;
  1786	  }
  1787	
  1788	  if (stats != nullptr) {
  1789	    stats->slotBySlotUs = slotBySlotUs;
  1790	    stats->slotBySlotSegs = slotBySlotSegs;
  1791	    stats->slotBySlotSlots = slotBySlotSlots;
  1792	  }
  1793	
  1794	  return Status::OK;
  1795	}
  1796	
  1797	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseCompile(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs) {
  1798	  DSP_REQUIRE_PLAN_PHASE_AT_MOST(PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN, "phaseCompile");
  1799	  if (compilationDone_) return;
  1800	  // Require at least one warmup execution so slot shape caches are populated.
  1801	  // Without shapes, Triton IR builds fail on cross-segment inputs.
  1802	  if (executeCount_ < 1) {
  1803	    DSP_DIAG(COMPILE, "phaseCompile: deferred (executeCount=%d, shapes not yet populated)", executeCount_);
  1804	    return;
  1805	  }
  1806	  DSP_DIAG(COMPILE, "phaseCompile: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d", (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs);
  1807	  platformPrecompileSegments(externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1808	  compilationDone_ = true;
  1809	  DSP_DIAG(COMPILE, "phaseCompile: END (compilationDone=true)");
  1810	}
  1811	
  1812	Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseSlotBySlot(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs,
  1813	                                               void* stream, PhaseExecutionStats* stats) {
  1814	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseSlotBySlot: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d", (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs);
  1815	
  1816	  long long slotBySlotUs = 0;
  1817	  int slotBySlotSegs = 0;
  1818	  int slotBySlotSlots = 0;
  1819	  using Clock = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock;
  1820	
  1821	  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
  1822	    if (!platformBindSegmentDevice(segment)) {
  1823	      return Status::KERNEL_FAILURE;
  1824	    }
  1825	    platformMigrateSegmentInputs(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1826	
  1827	    segment.exec.currentPhase = segment.def.isCapturable
  1828	        ? ExecutionPhase::WARMUP
  1829	        : ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
  1830	
  1831	    auto tSegStart = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
  1832	    auto status = executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
  1833	    if (status != Status::OK) return status;
  1834	
  1835	    if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
  1836	      auto segUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(Clock::now() - tSegStart).count();
  1837	      slotBySlotUs += segUs;
  1838	      slotBySlotSegs++;
  1839	      slotBySlotSlots += segment.def.endSlot - segment.def.startSlot + 1;
  1840	    }
  1841	
  1842	    platformCleanupMigratedInputs();
  1843	    auto postStatus = platformCheckPostSegment(segment);
  1844	    if (postStatus != Status::OK) return postStatus;
  1845	  }
  1846	
  1847	  if (stats != nullptr) {
  1848	    stats->slotBySlotUs = slotBySlotUs;
  1849	    stats->slotBySlotSegs = slotBySlotSegs;
  1850	    stats->slotBySlotSlots = slotBySlotSlots;
  1851	  }
  1852	
  1853	  return Status::OK;
  1854	}
  1855	
  1856	Status NativeDynamicShapePlan::phaseReplay(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExternalInputs,
  1857	                                           NDArray** requestedOutputs, int numRequestedOutputs,
  1858	                                           void* stream, PhaseExecutionStats* stats) {
  1859	  DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "phaseReplay: BEGIN segments=%d extInputs=%d frozen=%d phase=%d execCount=%d",
  1860	           (int)segments_.size(), numExternalInputs, shapesFrozen_ ? 1 : 0,
  1861	           static_cast<int>(planPhase_), executeCount_);
  1862	
  1863	  size_t poolUsedPreSegs = 0, poolReservedPreSegs = 0;
  1864	  platformPreReplayPoolStats(poolUsedPreSegs, poolReservedPreSegs);
  1865	
  1866	  long long graphReplayUs = 0, slotBySlotUs = 0;
  1867	  int graphReplaySegs = 0, slotBySlotSegs = 0, graphReplaySlots = 0, slotBySlotSlots = 0;
  1868	
  1869	  using Clock = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock;
  1870	
  1871	  for (auto& segment : segments_) {
  1872	    if (!platformBindSegmentDevice(segment)) {
  1873	      return Status::KERNEL_FAILURE;
  1874	    }
  1875	    platformMigrateSegmentInputs(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs);
  1876	
  1877	    bool useGraph = platformShouldUseGraph(segment);
  1878	    auto tSegStart = executionTimingEnabled_ ? Clock::now() : Clock::time_point{};
  1879	    bool segUsedGraph = false;
  1880	    int segSlots = segment.def.endSlot - segment.def.startSlot + 1;
  1881	
  1882	    if (segment.def.selectedBackend == SelectedBackend::EMULATED_REPLAY) {
  1883	      auto status = executeSegmentEmulatedReplay(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
  1884	      if (status != Status::OK) return status;
  1885	      segUsedGraph = true;
  1886	    } else if (useGraph) {
  1887	      auto status = platformExecuteSegmentWithBackends(
  1888	          segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream, segUsedGraph);
  1889	      if (status != Status::OK) return status;
  1890	    } else {
  1891	      segment.exec.currentPhase = segment.def.isCapturable
  1892	          ? ExecutionPhase::WARMUP
  1893	          : ExecutionPhase::SLOT_BY_SLOT;
  1894	      auto status = executeSegmentSlotBySlot(segment, externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
  1895	      if (status != Status::OK) return status;
  1896	    }
  1897	
  1898	    if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
  1899	      auto segUs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(Clock::now() - tSegStart).count();
  1900	      if (segUsedGraph) {
  1901	        graphReplayUs += segUs;
  1902	        graphReplaySegs++;
  1903	        graphReplaySlots += segSlots;
  1904	      } else {
  1905	        slotBySlotUs += segUs;
  1906	        slotBySlotSegs++;
  1907	        slotBySlotSlots += segSlots;
  1908	      }
  1909	    }
  1910	
  1911	    platformCleanupMigratedInputs();
  1912	    auto postStatus = platformCheckPostSegment(segment);
  1913	    if (postStatus != Status::OK) return postStatus;
  1914	
  1915	    // Trace slot reporting (GPU only)
  1916	    platformTraceSlotValues(segment, stream, executeCount_);
  1917	
  1918	    // NaN detection (gated behind tritonVerifyKernels)
  1919	    if (shapesFrozen_ && Environment::getInstance().tritonVerifyKernels()) {
  1920	      for (int stepIdx = segment.def.startSlot; stepIdx <= segment.def.endSlot; stepIdx++) {
  1921	        auto& slot = slots_[stepIdx];
  1922	        for (int o = 0; o < slot.wiring.numOutputs; o++) {
  1923	          int si = slot.wiring.outputSlotIndices[o];
  1924	          if (si < 0 || si >= totalOutputSlots_ || outputSlots_[si] == nullptr) continue;
  1925	          auto* arr = outputSlots_[si];
  1926	          auto* db = arr->dataBuffer();
  1927	          if (db == nullptr || DSP_BUF(arr) == nullptr || arr->lengthOf() == 0) continue;
  1928	          bool dbClosed = db->isClosed();
  1929	          if (dbClosed) {
  1930	            DSP_DIAG_SLOT(VERIFY, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
  1931	                    "NaN_CLOSED_DB seg[%d-%d] outSlot=%d DataBuffer CLOSED! "
  1932	                    "frozenConst=%d shapeStatic=%d execCount=%d",
  1933	                    segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, si,
  1934	                    slot.frozenConstantSlot() ? 1 : 0, slot.shapeCache.shapeStatic ? 1 : 0, executeCount_);
  1935	            continue;
  1936	          }
  1937	          arr->syncToHost();
  1938	          bool hasNaN = arr->hasNaNs();
  1939	          if (hasNaN) {
  1940	            bool anyInputNaN = false;
  1941	            for (int inp = 0; inp < slot.wiring.numInputs; inp++) {
  1942	              int srcIdx = slot.wiring.inputSourceIndices[inp];
  1943	              NDArray* srcArr = nullptr;
  1944	              if (srcIdx >= 0 && srcIdx < totalOutputSlots_) {
  1945	                srcArr = outputSlots_[srcIdx];
  1946	              } else if (srcIdx < 0) {
  1947	                int extIdx = -(srcIdx + 1);
  1948	                if (extIdx >= 0 && extIdx < numExternalInputs) srcArr = externalInputs[extIdx];
  1949	              }
  1950	              if (srcArr != nullptr && srcArr->lengthOf() > 0) {
  1951	                srcArr->syncToHost();
  1952	                bool inpHasNaN = srcArr->hasNaNs();
  1953	                if (inpHasNaN) anyInputNaN = true;
  1954	              }
  1955	            }
  1956	            DSP_DIAG_SLOT(VERIFY, stepIdx, slot.ident.opName.c_str(),
  1957	                    "NaN_DETECT seg[%d-%d] output[%d]=%d NaN! "
  1958	                    "useGraph=%d execCount=%d len=%lld inputsNaN=%d hasReplay=%d "
  1959	                    "frozenConst=%d shapeStatic=%d",
  1960	                    segment.def.startSlot, segment.def.endSlot, o, si,
  1961	                    useGraph ? 1 : 0, executeCount_, (long long)arr->lengthOf(),
  1962	                    anyInputNaN ? 1 : 0,
  1963	                    segment.exec.replayHandle != nullptr ? 1 : 0,
  1964	                    slot.frozenConstantSlot() ? 1 : 0, slot.shapeCache.shapeStatic ? 1 : 0);
  1965	            goto nanDetectDoneReplay;
  1966	          }
  1967	        }
  1968	      }
  1969	      nanDetectDoneReplay:;
  1970	    }
  1971	  }
  1972	
  1973	  // Post-segment pool trimming
  1974	  platformPostReplayPoolManagement(poolUsedPreSegs, shapesFrozen_, executeCount_);
  1975	
  1976	  // Copy requested outputs
  1977	  for (int i = 0; i < numRequestedOutputs_; i++) {
  1978	    int slotIdx = requestedOutputSlotIndices_[i];
  1979	    if (slotIdx >= 0 && slotIdx < totalOutputSlots_) {
  1980	      requestedOutputs[i] = outputSlots_[slotIdx];
  1981	    } else {
  1982	      requestedOutputs[i] = nullptr;
  1983	    }
  1984	  }
  1985	
  1986	  // KV cache retention
  1987	  if (kvCacheRetentionEnabled_) {
  1988	    scatterKvEntries(externalInputs, numExternalInputs, stream);
  1989	    kvCachePosition_++;
  1990	  }
  1991	
  1992	  // Timing breakdown
  1993	  if (executionTimingEnabled_) {
  1994	    DSP_DIAG(TIMING, "replay: graph=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots) sbs=%lldus(%d segs/%d slots)",
  1995	             graphReplayUs, graphReplaySegs, graphReplaySlots,
  1996	             slotBySlotUs, slotBySlotSegs, slotBySlotSlots);
  1997	  }
  1998	
  1999	  if (stats != nullptr) {
  2000	    stats->graphReplayUs = graphReplayUs;
  2001	    stats->slotBySlotUs = slotBySlotUs;
  2002	    stats->graphReplaySegs = graphReplaySegs;
  2003	    stats->slotBySlotSegs = slotBySlotSegs;
  2004	    stats->graphReplaySlots = graphReplaySlots;
  2005	    stats->slotBySlotSlots = slotBySlotSlots;
  2350	  maxKvCacheLen_ = maxLen;
  2351	}
  2352	
  2353	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::scatterKvEntries(NDArray** externalInputs, int numExt, void* stream) {
  2354	  if (!kvCacheRetentionEnabled_ || kvCacheNumMappings_ == 0) return;
  2355	
  2356	  // Scatter present KV outputs into external input (static) buffers.
  2357	  // GPU: uses kvScatter kernel + stream management.
  2358	  // CPU: uses operator() + assign() fallback.
  2359	  void* savedState = platformBeginKvScatter(stream);
  2360	
  2361	  auto resolveLiveArray = [](NDArray* arr) -> NDArray* {
  2362	    if (arr == nullptr) return nullptr;
  2363	    if (arr->isEmpty()) return arr;
  2364	    auto* db = arr->dataBuffer();
  2365	    return (db != nullptr && db->isValid()) ? arr : nullptr;
  2366	  };
  2367	
  2368	  // Collect valid scatter entries for batched dispatch
  2369	  std::vector<sd::ops::helpers::KvScatterEntry> batchEntries;
  2370	  batchEntries.reserve(kvCacheNumMappings_);
  2371	  // Track arrays for prepareSpecialUse/registerSpecialUse
  2372	  std::vector<std::pair<NDArray*, NDArray*>> scatterPairs;
  2373	  DataType batchDtype = DataType::HALF;  // default; set from first valid entry
  2374	
  2375	  int skipped = 0;
  2376	  for (int m = 0; m < kvCacheNumMappings_; m++) {
  2377	    KvCacheMapping& mapping = kvCacheMappings_[m];
  2378	
  2379	    int presentSlotIdx = mapping.presentOutputSlotIdx;
  2380	    if (presentSlotIdx < 0 || presentSlotIdx >= totalOutputSlots_) { skipped++; continue; }
  2381	
  2382	    NDArray* presentKv = resolveLiveArray(outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx]);
  2383	    if (presentKv == nullptr) {
  2384	      presentKv = resolveLiveArray(outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx]);
  2385	    } else if (outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx] != presentKv) {
  2386	      outputSlots_[presentSlotIdx] = presentKv;
  2387	    }
  2388	
  2389	    if (presentKv == nullptr) { skipped++; continue; }
  2390	
  2391	    int extIdx = mapping.pastInputExternalIdx;
  2392	    if (extIdx < 0 || extIdx >= numExt) { skipped++; continue; }
  2393	    NDArray* staticBuf = externalInputs[extIdx];
  2394	    if (staticBuf == nullptr) { skipped++; continue; }
  2395	
  2396	    if (presentKv->rankOf() != 4 || staticBuf->rankOf() != 4) { skipped++; continue; }
  2397	
  2398	    // Validate GPU buffer pointers are non-null and sequence dims are non-zero.
  2399	    // After resetForNextPage(), restored cached handles may encounter empty
  2400	    // destination buffers (shape [1,H,0,D]) whose specialBuffer() is nullptr.
  2401	    // Writing to nullptr causes CUDA error 700.
  2402	    NDArray::prepareSpecialUse({staticBuf}, {presentKv});
  2403	
  2404	    const void* srcBuf = DSP_BUF(presentKv);
  2405	    void* dstBuf = DSP_BUF(staticBuf);
  2406	    auto srcSeq = presentKv->sizeAt(2);
  2407	    auto dstSeq = staticBuf->sizeAt(2);
  2408	
  2409	    if (srcBuf == nullptr || dstBuf == nullptr || srcSeq <= 0 || dstSeq <= 0) {
  2410	      NDArray::registerSpecialUse({staticBuf}, {presentKv}); // balance the prepareSpecialUse
  2411	      skipped++;
  2412	      continue;
  2413	    }
  2414	
  2415	    // Validate cachePos is within the destination buffer's bounds
  2416	    if (kvCachePosition_ >= dstSeq) {
  2417	      NDArray::registerSpecialUse({staticBuf}, {presentKv}); // balance the prepareSpecialUse
  2418	      skipped++;
  2419	      continue;
  2420	    }
  2421	
  2422	    sd::ops::helpers::KvScatterEntry entry;
  2423	    entry.srcPtr = srcBuf;
  2424	    entry.dstPtr = dstBuf;
  2425	    entry.heads = presentKv->sizeAt(1);
  2426	    entry.srcSeqLen = srcSeq;
  2427	    entry.dstSeqLen = dstSeq;
  2428	    entry.dim = presentKv->sizeAt(3);
  2429	    entry.lastPos = entry.srcSeqLen - 1;
  2430	    entry.cachePos = kvCachePosition_;
  2431	    batchEntries.push_back(entry);
  2432	    if (scatterPairs.empty()) {
  2433	      batchDtype = presentKv->dataType();
  2434	    }
  2435	    scatterPairs.push_back({presentKv, staticBuf});
  2436	  }
  2437	
  2438	  int scattered = static_cast<int>(batchEntries.size());
  2439	  if (scattered > 0) {
  2440	    auto* lc = LaunchContext::defaultContext();
  2441	    sd::ops::helpers::kvScatterBatched(batchEntries.data(), scattered, batchDtype, lc);
  2442	
  2443	    platformPostKvScatterSync(scattered, kvCachePosition_, kvCacheNumMappings_);
  2444	  }
  2445	
  2446	  // Register special use for all pairs
  2447	  for (auto& pair : scatterPairs) {
  2448	    NDArray::registerSpecialUse({pair.second}, {pair.first});
  2449	  }
  2450	
  2451	  platformEndKvScatter(savedState);
  2452	
  2453	  DSP_DIAG(KV_CACHE, "KV scatter (batched): %d scattered, %d skipped, pos=%d, numMappings=%d, execCount=%lld",
  2454	           scattered, skipped, kvCachePosition_, kvCacheNumMappings_, (long long)executeCount_);
  2455	  if (DSP_DIAG_ENABLED(KV_CACHE) && scattered > 0) {
  2456	    auto& e0 = batchEntries[0];

   208	     * Optionally run GraphOptimizer on the loaded model and cache the result.

   210	    private static SameDiff maybeOptimize(SameDiff sd, File onnxFile, boolean optimizerEnabled, boolean cacheDisabled) {
   211	        if (!optimizerEnabled) {

   215	        int opsBefore = sd.getOps().size();

   217	        // Also skip the vision encoder (< 3000 ops) which has a LONG constant
   218	        // endianness issue during dup(). The decoder (4441+ ops) is the target.
   219	        if (opsBefore < 3000) {

   221	            return sd;

   223

   228	        SameDiff optimized = GraphOptimizer.optimize(sd, outputs);

   231	        long optElapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - optStart;

   233	                opsBefore, opsAfter, opsBefore - opsAfter, optElapsed, onnxFile.getName());

   235	        // Cache the optimized graph for future runs
   236	        if (!cacheDisabled) {
   237	            File optSdzFile = getOptimizedSdzCacheFile(onnxFile);

   239	                long saveStart = System.currentTimeMillis();

   241	                        "source_onnx", onnxFile.getName(),
   242	                        "optimized", "true",
   243	                        "ops_before", String.valueOf(opsBefore),
   244	                        "ops_after", String.valueOf(opsAfter)
   245	                ));
   246	                long saveElapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - saveStart;
   247	                log.info("Cached optimized SDZ in {}ms: {} ({} bytes)",
   248	                        saveElapsed, optSdzFile.getName(), optSdzFile.length());
   249	            } catch (Exception e) {
   250	                log.warn("Failed to cache optimized SDZ (non-fatal): {}", e.getMessage());
   251	                if (optSdzFile.exists()) {
   252	                    optSdzFile.delete();
   253	                }
   254	            }
   255	        }

   661	        IntPointer mappingsPtr = new IntPointer(mappings);
   662	        try {
   663	            nativeOps.configurePlanKvCacheRetention(
   664	                    nativePlanHandle, mappingsPtr, numMappings, maxKvLen, initialPos);
   665	        } finally {

   672	        // Save configuration for re-application after plan recompilation.

   676	        this.savedKvPastInputNames = new ArrayList<>(pastInputNames);

   678	        this.savedKvCurrentPos = initialPos;

   680	        log.info("KV cache retention configured: {} mappings, maxLen={}, initialPos={}, retainedOutputs={}",
   681	                numMappings, maxKvLen, initialPos, kvRetentionOutputNames.size());

   685	    /**

   689	     * (they may map to different slot indices).

   692	        if (savedKvPresentOutputNames == null || nativePlanHandle == null) return;

   694	        // Temporarily clear the flag so configureKvCacheRetention can set it fresh
   695	        this.kvCacheRetentionConfigured = false;

   697	                savedKvPresentOutputNames, savedKvPastInputNames,
   698	                savedKvMaxLen, savedKvCurrentPos);
   699	        if (!ok) {

   701	                     "C++ scatter will be disabled for this plan.");

   703	            this.kvCacheRetentionConfigured = false;

   781	                case "position_ids":   posIdsIdx = i; break;
   782	                case "attention_mask": attnMaskIdx = i; break;

     6	 *
     7	 * Key observations from prior isolation:
     8	 *   - No C++ changes between baseline and HEAD → regression is purely Java
     9	 *   - --no-triton: still degenerate (26/250)
    10	 *   - --no-native-decode: still degenerate (26/250)
    11	 *   - --no-attn-override: still degenerate (17/250)
    12	 *   - --no-freeze: CRASH (released buffer)
    13	 *   - --no-direct: CRASH (released buffer)
    14	 *   - TokenSample vs argMax: both degenerate
    15	 *   - Position tracking: confirmed correct (680, 681, 682... incrementing)
    16	 *
    17	 * NEW hypothesis: cuBLAS TF32 (added to OPTIMAL config since baseline) OR
    18	 * the frozen fast path D2D copy not picking up in-place bias/mask updates.
    19	 */
    20	package org.eclipse.deeplearning4j.nd4j.autodiff.samediff;

    68	    @Test
    69	    @DisplayName("Matmul with TF32 ON vs OFF should produce similar but not identical results")
    70	    public void testMatmulTf32PrecisionDifference() {
    71	        var env = Nd4j.getEnvironment();
    72	        boolean original = env.cublasTf32Enabled();
    73	        try {
    74	            // Create realistic matmul inputs (like a decoder layer)
    75	            // [1, 2048] x [2048, 2048] — typical hidden→hidden projection
    76	            INDArray a = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, 2048);
    77	            INDArray b = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 2048, 2048);
    78	
    79	            // TF32 OFF (IEEE FP32)
    80	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(false);
    81	            INDArray resultIeee = a.mmul(b);
    82	
    83	            // TF32 ON (reduced precision tensor cores)
    84	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(true);
    85	            INDArray resultTf32 = a.mmul(b);
    86	
    87	            // They should be close but may differ
    88	            double maxDiff = resultIeee.sub(resultTf32).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
    89	            System.out.println("Max absolute difference (TF32 vs IEEE): " + maxDiff);
    90	
    91	            // TF32 has 10-bit mantissa vs 23-bit for FP32.
    92	            // For a 2048-wide dot product, error can compound.
    93	            // Just verify both produce valid (non-NaN, non-Inf) results.
    94	            assertFalse(resultIeee.isNaN().any(), "IEEE result has NaN");
    95	            assertFalse(resultTf32.isNaN().any(), "TF32 result has NaN");
    96	            assertFalse(resultIeee.isInfinite().any(), "IEEE result has Inf");
    97	            assertFalse(resultTf32.isInfinite().any(), "TF32 result has Inf");
    98	        } finally {
    99	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(original);
   100	        }
   101	    }

   103	    @Test
   104	    @DisplayName("Chained matmuls with TF32 should not diverge catastrophically over 30 layers")
   105	    public void testChainedMatmulTf32Divergence() {
   106	        var env = Nd4j.getEnvironment();
   107	        boolean original = env.cublasTf32Enabled();
   108	        try {
   109	            // Simulate 30 transformer layers: x = x @ W for each layer
   110	            int hidden = 2048;
   111	            INDArray x = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, 1, hidden).mul(0.01);
   112	
   113	            // Generate 30 weight matrices (shared between TF32 and IEEE runs)
   114	            INDArray[] weights = new INDArray[30];
   115	            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   116	                weights[i] = Nd4j.randn(DataType.FLOAT, hidden, hidden).mul(0.02);
   117	            }
   118	
   119	            // IEEE run
   120	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(false);
   121	            INDArray xIeee = x.dup();
   122	            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   123	                xIeee = xIeee.mmul(weights[i]);
   124	            }
   125	
   126	            // TF32 run
   127	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(true);
   128	            INDArray xTf32 = x.dup();
   129	            for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   130	                xTf32 = xTf32.mmul(weights[i]);
   131	            }
   132	
   133	            double maxDiff = xIeee.sub(xTf32).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   134	            double ieeeMax = xIeee.amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   135	            double relDiff = ieeeMax > 0 ? maxDiff / ieeeMax : maxDiff;
   136	
   137	            System.out.println("After 30 chained matmuls:");
   138	            System.out.println("  IEEE max abs: " + ieeeMax);
   139	            System.out.println("  TF32 max abs: " + xTf32.amaxNumber().doubleValue());
   140	            System.out.println("  Max absolute diff: " + maxDiff);
   141	            System.out.println("  Relative diff: " + relDiff);
   142	
   143	            // Both should still be valid
   144	            assertFalse(xIeee.isNaN().any(), "IEEE result has NaN after 30 layers");
   145	            assertFalse(xTf32.isNaN().any(), "TF32 result has NaN after 30 layers");
   146	        } finally {
   147	            env.setCublasTf32Enabled(original);
   148	        }
   149	    }

   153	    @Test
   154	    @DisplayName("putScalar on FLOAT array followed by ensureLocation(DEVICE) should be visible")
   155	    public void testPutScalarEnsureLocationVisibility() {
   156	        // Simulates the attn_mask_reformat bias update pattern:
   157	        //   bias.putScalar({0,0,0,pos}, 0.0f);
   158	        //   ensureLocation(bias, DEVICE);
   159	        // If ensureLocation doesn't actually trigger H2D, the device buffer is stale.
   160	        INDArray bias = Nd4j.valueArrayOf(new long[]{1, 1, 1, 100}, MASK_FILL, DataType.FLOAT);
   161	        Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(bias,
   162	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   163	
   164	        // Unmask positions one at a time (simulating decode steps)
   165	        for (int pos = 0; pos < 50; pos++) {
   166	            bias.putScalar(new long[]{0, 0, 0, pos}, 0.0f);
   167	            Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(bias,
   168	                    org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   169	        }
   170	
   171	        // Read back and verify all 50 positions are unmasked
   172	        for (int pos = 0; pos < 50; pos++) {
   173	            float val = bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, pos);
   174	            assertEquals(0.0f, val, 1e-6f,
   175	                    "Position " + pos + " should be unmasked (0.0) but got " + val);
   176	        }
   177	        // Verify remaining positions still masked
   178	        for (int pos = 50; pos < 100; pos++) {
   179	            float val = bias.getFloat(0, 0, 0, pos);
   180	            assertEquals(MASK_FILL, val, 1e-6f,
   181	                    "Position " + pos + " should still be masked");
   182	        }
   183	    }

   185	    @Test
   186	    @DisplayName("putScalar on LONG array (attention_mask) followed by ensureLocation(DEVICE)")
   187	    public void testLongMaskPutScalarVisibility() {
   188	        // Simulates 1D attention mask update pattern
   189	        long maxKvLen = 729;
   190	        long currentSeqLen = 1;
   191	        long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + currentSeqLen;
   192	
   193	        INDArray mask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, totalSeqLen);
   194	        // Set prefill positions
   195	        int prefillLen = 679;
   196	        mask.get(org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   197	                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.interval(0, prefillLen)).assign(1);
   198	        mask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1);
   199	
   200	        Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(mask,
   201	                org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   202	
   203	        // Simulate 20 decode steps — each unmasks one more position
   204	        for (int step = 0; step < 20; step++) {
   205	            long cachePos = prefillLen + step;
   206	            if (cachePos > 0) {
   207	                mask.put(new org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.INDArrayIndex[]{
   208	                                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   209	                                org.nd4j.linalg.indexing.NDArrayIndex.point(cachePos)},
   210	                        Nd4j.scalar(DataType.LONG, 1));
   211	                Nd4j.getAffinityManager().ensureLocation(mask,
   212	                        org.nd4j.linalg.api.concurrency.AffinityManager.Location.DEVICE);
   213	            }
   214	        }
   215	
   216	        // Verify: positions 0..prefillLen+19 should be 1, the rest 0 (except last)
   217	        long expectedOnes = prefillLen + 20 + 1; // prefill + 20 decode steps + last position
   218	        long actualSum = mask.sumNumber().longValue();
   219	        assertEquals(expectedOnes, actualSum,
   220	                "Expected " + expectedOnes + " ones in mask but got " + actualSum);

 succeeded in 0ms:
   160	            sd.close();
   161	        }
   162	    }

   247	    // =========================================================================
   248	    // Test 3: Step-by-step divergence — at which step does StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop
   249	    // diverge from manual decode? Compares token-by-token.
   250	    // =========================================================================
   251	
   252	    @Test
   253	    @Order(3)
   254	    @DisplayName("3. Step-by-step divergence: manual vs StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop")
   255	    public void testStepByStepDivergence() {
   256	        if (manualDecodeTokens == null || manualDecodeTokens.isEmpty()) {
   257	            log.warn("Skipping — manual decode tokens not available (test 1 may have failed)");
   258	            return;
   259	        }
   260	
   261	        resetDecoder();
   262	
   263	        System.setProperty("nd4j.dsp.noDirect", "true");
   264	        try {
   265	            StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop loop = StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.builder()
   266	                    .decoder(decoder)
   267	                    .embedTokens(embedTokens)
   268	                    .tokenizer(tokenizer)
   269	                    .samplingConfig(SamplingConfig.greedy())
   270	                    .maxNewTokens(10)
   271	                    .hiddenSize((int) benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[2])
   272	                    .build();
   273	
   274	            GenerationResult loopResult = loop.decode(benchmarkEmbeddings.dup(), benchmarkPromptTokenIds);
   275	
   276	            log.info("Manual tokens: {}", manualDecodeTokens.subList(0, Math.min(10, manualDecodeTokens.size())));
   277	            log.info("Loop tokens:   {}", Arrays.toString(loopResult.getTokenIds()));
   278	
   279	            int divergeStep = -1;
   280	            int maxCompare = Math.min(Math.min(manualDecodeTokens.size(), loopResult.getTokenIds().length), 10);
   281	            for (int i = 0; i < maxCompare; i++) {
   282	                int manual = manualDecodeTokens.get(i);
   283	                int loopTok = loopResult.getTokenIds()[i];
   284	                String manualText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{manual}, false);
   285	                String loopText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{loopTok}, false);
   286	                boolean match = manual == loopTok;
   287	                log.info("Step {}: manual={}('{}') loop={}('{}') {}",
   288	                        i, manual, manualText, loopTok, loopText, match ? "MATCH" : "*** DIVERGE ***");
   289	                if (!match && divergeStep < 0) {
   290	                    divergeStep = i;
   291	                }
   292	            }
   293	
   294	            if (divergeStep >= 0) {
   295	                log.warn("FINDING: Outputs diverge at step {}.", divergeStep);
   296	                if (divergeStep == 0) {
   297	                    log.warn("  Diverges at PREFILL — same code path, different result. Check session state.");
   298	                } else if (divergeStep == 1) {
   299	                    log.warn("  Diverges at first DECODE step — padded KV transition is suspect.");
   300	                } else {
   301	                    log.warn("  Diverges at step {} — KV scatter or attention mask accumulation error.", divergeStep);
   302	                }
   303	            } else {
   304	                log.info("FINDING: Manual and StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop produce IDENTICAL tokens for {} steps", maxCompare);
   305	            }
   306	        } finally {
   307	            System.clearProperty("nd4j.dsp.noDirect");
   308	            resetDecoder();
   309	        }
   310	    }

   397	    // Test 6: Attention mask verification — compare what manual decode
   398	    // and padded mode produce at step 2 for the actual model inputs.
   399	    // =========================================================================
   400	
   401	    @Test
   402	    @Order(6)
   403	    @DisplayName("6. Attention mask: manual (all-ones) vs padded (sparse) produce same logits at step 2")
   404	    public void testAttentionMaskEquivalence() {
   405	        resetDecoder();
   406	        INDArray embeddingTable = extractEmbeddingTable();
   407	        assertNotNull(embeddingTable, "Embedding table not found");
   408	
   409	        long seqLen = benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[1];
   410	        long hiddenSize = benchmarkEmbeddings.shape()[2];
   411	
   412	        String logitsName = findLogitsName();
   413	        List<String> kvOutputNames = findKvOutputNames();
   414	        List<String> allOutputs = new ArrayList<>();
   415	        allOutputs.add(logitsName);
   416	        allOutputs.addAll(kvOutputNames);
   417	
   418	        // === PREFILL (same for both paths) ===
   419	        Map<String, INDArray> inputs = buildPrefillInputs(seqLen);
   420	        Map<String, INDArray> prefillResult = decoder.output(inputs, allOutputs.toArray(new String[0]));
   421	        INDArray prefillLogits = prefillResult.get(logitsName);
   422	        INDArray lastLogits = prefillLogits.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0),
   423	                NDArrayIndex.point(seqLen - 1), NDArrayIndex.all());
   424	        int firstToken = lastLogits.argMax().getInt(0);
   425	
   426	        // Save KV for manual path
   427	        Map<String, INDArray> manualKv = new HashMap<>();
   428	        for (String kvName : kvOutputNames) {
   429	            String pastName = kvName.replace("present", "past_key_values");
   430	            manualKv.put(pastName, prefillResult.get(kvName).dup());
   431	        }
   432	
   433	        // Save KV for padded path (pad to static size)
   434	        long maxKvLen = seqLen + 30;
   435	        Map<String, INDArray> staticKv = new HashMap<>();
   436	        for (String kvName : kvOutputNames) {
   437	            String pastName = kvName.replace("present", "past_key_values");
   438	            INDArray kv = prefillResult.get(kvName);
   439	            long[] shape = kv.shape(); // [1, heads, seqLen, dim]
   440	            INDArray padded = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.FLOAT, shape[0], shape[1], maxKvLen, shape[3]);
   441	            padded.get(NDArrayIndex.all(), NDArrayIndex.all(),
   442	                    NDArrayIndex.interval(0, shape[2]), NDArrayIndex.all()).assign(kv);
   443	            staticKv.put(pastName, padded);
   444	        }
   445	
   446	        // === STEP 1: Manual path (growing KV, all-ones mask) ===
   447	        resetDecoder();
   448	        INDArray tokenEmbed = embeddingTable.getRow(firstToken).reshape(1, 1, hiddenSize);
   449	        Map<String, INDArray> manualInputs = new HashMap<>();
   450	        for (String name : decoder.inputs()) {
   451	            if (name.equals("inputs_embeds")) manualInputs.put(name, tokenEmbed);
   452	            else if (name.equals("attention_mask")) manualInputs.put(name, Nd4j.ones(DataType.LONG, 1, seqLen + 1));
   453	            else if (name.equals("position_ids")) manualInputs.put(name, Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[]{seqLen}).reshape(1, 1));
   454	            else if (name.startsWith("past_key_values.") && manualKv.containsKey(name)) manualInputs.put(name, manualKv.get(name));
   455	        }
   456	        Map<String, INDArray> manualStep1 = decoder.output(manualInputs, logitsName);
   457	        INDArray manualLogits1 = manualStep1.get(logitsName).dup();
   458	        int manualToken1 = manualLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all())
   459	                .argMax().getInt(0);
   460	
   461	        // === STEP 1: Padded path (full static KV, sparse mask) ===
   462	        resetDecoder();
   463	        long totalSeqLen = maxKvLen + 1;
   464	        INDArray sparseMask = Nd4j.zeros(DataType.LONG, 1, totalSeqLen);
   465	        sparseMask.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.interval(0, seqLen)).assign(1);
   466	        sparseMask.putScalar(0, totalSeqLen - 1, 1); // current token
   467	
   468	        Map<String, INDArray> paddedInputs = new HashMap<>();
   469	        for (String name : decoder.inputs()) {
   470	            if (name.equals("inputs_embeds")) paddedInputs.put(name, tokenEmbed);
   471	            else if (name.equals("attention_mask")) paddedInputs.put(name, sparseMask);
   472	            else if (name.equals("position_ids")) paddedInputs.put(name, Nd4j.createFromArray(new long[]{seqLen}).reshape(1, 1));
   473	            else if (name.startsWith("past_key_values.") && staticKv.containsKey(name)) paddedInputs.put(name, staticKv.get(name));
   474	        }
   475	        Map<String, INDArray> paddedStep1 = decoder.output(paddedInputs, logitsName);
   476	        INDArray paddedLogits1 = paddedStep1.get(logitsName).dup();
   477	        int paddedToken1 = paddedLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all())
   478	                .argMax().getInt(0);
   479	
   480	        // Compare
   481	        String manualText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{manualToken1}, false);
   482	        String paddedText = tokenizer.decode(new int[]{paddedToken1}, false);
   483	        log.info("Step 1 comparison:");
   484	        log.info("  Manual (all-ones mask, growing KV):  token={} text='{}'", manualToken1, manualText);
   485	        log.info("  Padded (sparse mask, static KV):     token={} text='{}'", paddedToken1, paddedText);
   486	
   487	        // Compare top-5
   488	        INDArray manualL = manualLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all());
   489	        INDArray paddedL = paddedLogits1.get(NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.point(0), NDArrayIndex.all());
   490	
   491	        double maxLogitDiff = manualL.sub(paddedL).amaxNumber().doubleValue();
   492	        log.info("  Max logit difference: {}", maxLogitDiff);
   493	
   494	        if (manualToken1 != paddedToken1) {
   495	            log.warn("FINDING: Manual and padded paths produce DIFFERENT tokens at step 1!");
   496	            log.warn("  This means padded KV + sparse attention mask changes model behavior.");
   497	            log.warn("  Root cause: attn_mask_reformat with sparse mask produces different attention bias.");
   498	
   499	            // Log top-5 for each
   500	            logTop5("Manual", manualL);
   501	            logTop5("Padded", paddedL);
   502	        } else {
   503	            log.info("  Tokens MATCH at step 1.");
   504	        }
   505	
   506	        // Clean up static KV
   507	        for (INDArray buf : staticKv.values()) {
   508	            if (buf != null && !buf.wasClosed()) { buf.setCloseable(true); buf.close(); }
   509	        }
   510	        for (INDArray buf : manualKv.values()) {
   511	            if (buf != null && !buf.wasClosed()) { buf.setCloseable(true); buf.close(); }
   512	        }
   513	
   514	        assertEquals(manualToken1, paddedToken1,
   515	                "Padded path should produce same token as manual path at step 1. " +
   516	                        "Manual='" + manualText + "' Padded='" + paddedText + "' maxLogitDiff=" + maxLogitDiff);
   517	    }

  1573	void NativeDynamicShapePlan::advancePlanPhase() {
  1574	  // ── Plan-level phase advancement ───────────────────────────────────────────
  1575	  // Phase transitions are automatic based on observed stability:
  1576	  //   SHAPES_FROZEN → POINTERS_STABLE: after 2+ frozen executions with every
  1577	  //                                     replay-eligible segment in pointer-stable state
  1578	  //   POINTERS_STABLE → REPLAYING:     when every replay-eligible segment reaches
  1579	  //                                     backend-specific replay steady state
  1580	  //
  1581	  // Caller is responsible for: incrementing frozenExecutionCount_, capturing
  1582	  // frozenSnapshot_ on first frozen execution.
  1583	  if (!shapesFrozen_ || planPhase_ < PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN) return;
  1584	
  1585	  // Check pointer stability across all replay-eligible segments.
  1586	  if (planPhase_ == PlanPhase::SHAPES_FROZEN && frozenExecutionCount_ >= 2) {
  1587	    bool allStable = true;
  1588	    for (auto& seg : segments_) {
  1589	      if (!segmentHasStablePointersForPlanPhase(seg, slots_)) {
  1590	        allStable = false;
  1591	        break;
  1592	      }
  1593	    }
  1594	    if (allStable) {
  1595	      pointersStable_ = true;
  1596	      const char* oldPhase = dsp::planPhaseName(planPhase_);
  1597	      planPhase_ = PlanPhase::POINTERS_STABLE;
  1598	      DSP_DIAG(EXECUTE, "PLAN_PHASE: %s → POINTERS_STABLE (frozenExec=%d)",

**Current State**
- After prefill, the loop does the intended static-KV transition: pad KV into fixed buffers, recompile the decoder to `logits`-only outputs, freeze shapes, then configure native KV retention/scatter. See [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:581](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:581), [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:619](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:619), [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:683](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:683), [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:695](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:695), and [StaticKvCacheManager.java:115](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheManager.java:115).
- Decode inputs are still built in Java on every step. The loop explicitly does not use native decode-input management here; it rebuilds `attention_mask`, `_causal_mask`, `position_ids`, and past-KV inputs through `DecoderUtils.buildDecoderInputMap()`. - `output()` vs `outputDirect()` is probably not the core issue. `useDirect` only changes the Java-side fast path from step 2 onward, but both `SameDiff.output()` and `outputDirect()` still route through `InferenceSession` into `DynamicShapePlanExecutor.execute()` and then native DSP execution. See [StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:456](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/StaticKvCacheDecodeLoop.java:456), [SameDiff.java:3214](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/SameDiff.java:3214), [SameDiff.java:3240](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/SameDiff.java:3240), [InferenceSession.java:1271](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/internal/InferenceSession.java:1271), and [DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:1369](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/execution/DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:1369).
- The 7 tok/s symptom does match “not replaying”. But the phase machine itself is still being called after every frozen execute. If the plan stays at `SHAPES_FROZEN`, the more likely explanation is that at least one capturable segment never reaches pointer-stable / replay-stable state. See [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:1403](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:1403), [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:1573](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:1573), [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:106](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:106), and [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:137](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:137).
- The strongest native replay suspect is still Triton arg-table refresh instability. On failure it explicitly drops back to slot-by-slot and clears replay stability, which would keep the plan pinned below replay. See [NativeDynamicShapePlan_gpubackend.cpp:2934](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan_gpubackend.cpp:2934).
- The stale optimized decoder cache is a real confounder. `--no-clear-decoder` preserves `smoldocling-decoder.opt.sdz`, and cache validity only checks file timestamps against the `.onnx` and base `.sdz`, not optimizer/importer/code version. See [run-benchmark.sh:171](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/run-benchmark.sh:171), [run-benchmark.sh:248](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/run-benchmark.sh:248), and [OnnxModelCache.java:138](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-vlm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/model/OnnxModelCache.java:138).
- On KV scatter itself, native retention maps present-output slots to past-input external indices in Java, then the C++ scatter always copies the last source position `srcSeqLen - 1` into `cachePos`. That is correct only if the optimized decoder still appends the newest KV at the last position. See [DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:628](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/nd4j-backends/nd4j-api-parent/nd4j-api/src/main/java/org/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/execution/DynamicShapePlanExecutor.java:628), [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2353](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2353), and [NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2422](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/libnd4j/include/graph/impl/NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp:2422).
- The padded attention path is structurally trying to expose all past positions, not just the current token: `attention_mask` marks `[0, cachePos)` plus the last current-token slot, and the 4D bias masks `[cachePos, maxKvLen)` while leaving the appended current token visible. But this area is still fragile, and the tests already document a `cachePos` edge case. See [DecoderUtils.java:700](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/DecoderUtils.java:700), [DecoderUtils.java:820](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/nd4j/samediff-llm/src/main/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/llm/generation/DecoderUtils.java:820), [DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest.java:191](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest.java:191), and [DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest.java:267](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest.java:267).

**Compatibility, Testing, Risks**
- Cache invalidation is backward compatible but will force a one-time re-import/re-optimize of old decoder caches.
- Native diagnostics should be wired through DSP diagnostics, not ad-hoc prints, so normal benchmark behavior stays unchanged.
- Any attention-mask/bias change is high risk because current tests already encode the existing semantics; update those tests in lockstep.
- Start validation with existing isolation coverage in [TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/vlm/TestBenchmarkAccuracyIsolation.java:203), [StaticKvDecodeRegressionTest.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/StaticKvDecodeRegressionTest.java:185), and [DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest.java](/home/agibsonccc/Documents/GitHub/deeplearning4j/platform-tests/src/test/java/org/eclipse/deeplearning4j/nd4j/autodiff/samediff/DecodeFeatureInteractionRegressionTest.java:267). If those pass on a fresh `.opt.sdz` and the benchmark still stalls at `SHAPES_FROZEN`, the blocker is almost certainly native replay stability rather than decode-input preparation.
